name: Spaghetti Carbonara
description: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, pancetta, and black pepper.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to package instructions until al dente.
Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the pancetta and cook until crispy, about 5-7 minutes. If using garlic, add it in the last minute of cooking.
In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, grated cheeses, and a generous amount of black pepper.
When the pasta is done, reserve 1/2 cup of the pasta water, then drain the pasta.
Working quickly, add the hot pasta to the skillet with the pancetta. Remove from heat.
Add the egg and cheese mixture, tossing quickly to coat the pasta before the eggs scramble. Add a splash of the reserved pasta water to create a creamy sauce.
Serve immediately with additional grated cheese and freshly ground black pepper.

name: Avocado Toast with Poached Eggs
description: A nutritious and filling breakfast combining creamy avocado with perfectly poached eggs.
ingredients: Fresh herbs (like cilantro or chives) for garnish
instructions: Toast the bread slices until golden and crisp.
Cut the avocado in half, remove the pit, scoop out the flesh, and place in a small bowl. Add lemon juice, salt, and pepper, then mash with a fork to your desired consistency.
Bring a pot of water to a gentle simmer. Add white vinegar.
Crack each egg into a small cup. Create a gentle whirlpool in the water and carefully slide in the eggs one at a time. Cook for 3-4 minutes for a runny yolk.
Spread the mashed avocado evenly on the toast slices.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the poached eggs and place one on each toast.
Season with additional salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes if desired. Garnish with fresh herbs.

name: Thai Green Curry with Vegetables
description: A fragrant and spicy Thai curry loaded with colorful vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the coconut milk, vegetable broth, soy sauce, and brown sugar. Stir well and bring to a simmer.
Add the vegetables, starting with the ones that take longer to cook (carrots, eggplant), followed by quicker-cooking ones (bell pepper, zucchini, broccoli, snap peas).
Simmer for about 10-15 minutes until all vegetables are tender but still have some bite.
Stir in the Thai basil leaves and kaffir lime leaves if using.
Serve hot over steamed jasmine rice with lime wedges on the side.

name: Classic Greek Salad
description: A refreshing Mediterranean salad with crisp vegetables, feta cheese, and olives.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, and bell pepper.
Add the feta cheese and olives.
In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently to combine.
Let the salad sit for about 10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: A popular Indian curry with tender pieces of chicken in a creamy tomato sauce.
ingredients: 500g boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: In a large bowl, combine yogurt, lemon juice, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp coriander, 1/2 tsp turmeric, 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper, and 1 tsp garam masala. Add chicken and mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour (preferably 4-6 hours).
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the marinated chicken and cook until browned, about 8-10 minutes. Remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the onion and cook until soft, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and ginger, cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the remaining cumin, coriander, turmeric, cayenne pepper, and garam masala. Stir for 30 seconds.
Add the tomato puree and simmer for 10-15 minutes until it thickens.
Add the heavy cream and return the chicken to the skillet. Simmer for another 10 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked and the sauce has thickened.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with steamed basmati rice and naan bread if desired.

name: Quinoa Vegetable Bowl
description: A nutritious bowl of protein-rich quinoa topped with roasted vegetables and a tahini dressing.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cook quinoa in vegetable broth according to package instructions, typically simmering for 15-20 minutes until the liquid is absorbed. Fluff with a fork.

Toss sweet potato, bell pepper, zucchini, and red onion with olive oil, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper. Spread on the prepared baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes until tender and slightly caramelized.
While vegetables are roasting, make the tahini dressing: Whisk together tahini, lemon juice, garlic, water, and salt until smooth.
Assemble the bowls: Place a bed of quinoa in each bowl, top with roasted vegetables, fresh spinach, cherry tomatoes, and avocado slices.
Sprinkle with pepitas and drizzle with tahini dressing.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Soft and chewy cookies with melty chocolate chips - a classic favorite!
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
In a small bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, and salt.
In a large bowl, beat butter, granulated sugar, brown sugar, and vanilla extract until creamy.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Gradually beat in flour mixture until well combined.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto the prepared baking sheets, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
Bake for 9-11 minutes or until golden brown. Let stand on baking sheets for 2 minutes, then transfer to wire racks to cool completely.

name: Beef Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry with tender beef strips and crisp vegetables.
ingredients: Sesame seeds and sliced green onions for garnish
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the sauce ingredients: soy sauce, oyster sauce, rice vinegar, brown sugar, sesame oil, cornstarch, and water. Set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat. Add the beef strips and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until browned but still slightly pink in the center. Remove and set aside.
Add the remaining tablespoon of oil to the wok. Add garlic and ginger, stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the onion and carrots, stir-fry for 2 minutes. Add bell peppers and broccoli, stir-fry for another 3-4 minutes until vegetables are crisp-tender.
Return the beef to the wok. Pour in the sauce and stir to combine. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens and everything is well coated.
Serve hot over cooked rice, garnished with sesame seeds and sliced green onions.

name: Mushroom Risotto
description: A creamy Italian rice dish with earthy mushrooms and Parmesan cheese.
ingredients: 6 cups vegetable or chicken broth, heated
300g mixed mushrooms (such as button, cremini, shiitake), sliced
instructions: In a large pot, heat the broth and keep it warm over low heat.
In a large, heavy-bottomed pan, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add onion and cook until soft and translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and begin to brown, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the Arborio rice and stir to coat with oil, toasting for about 2 minutes.
Add the white wine and stir until absorbed.
Begin adding the warm broth, one ladle at a time, stirring constantly. Wait until each addition is almost fully absorbed before adding the next. This process should take about 20-25 minutes.
Once the rice is creamy and al dente (tender but with a slight bite), remove from heat. Stir in the Parmesan cheese, butter, and parsley. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Let stand for 2 minutes before serving.

name: Berry Smoothie Bowl
description: A nutritious and colorful breakfast bowl packed with antioxidants and topped with crunchy granola.
ingredients: 1 cup mixed frozen berries (strawberries, blueberries, raspberries)
1/4 cup almond milk (or milk of choice)
instructions: Place frozen berries, frozen banana, Greek yogurt, almond milk, and sweetener (if using) in a blender.
Blend until smooth and creamy. The mixture should be thicker than a regular smoothie.
Pour into a bowl.
Arrange toppings artfully on top: granola, chia seeds, fresh berries, sliced banana, and a drizzle of almond butter.
Enjoy immediately with a spoon.

name: Chicken Biryani
description: A fragrant Indian rice dish layered with spiced chicken, herbs, and caramelized onions.
ingredients: Saffron strands soaked in 2 tbsp warm milk
instructions: Wash and soak the basmati rice for 30 minutes. Drain.
In a large bowl, marinate the chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, red chili powder, half of the biryani masala, and salt. Set aside for at least 30 minutes.
Heat 2 tbsp ghee in a large heavy-bottomed pot. Add the sliced onions and fry until golden brown. Remove half and set aside for garnish.
To the remaining onions, add cumin seeds, cardamom, cloves, bay leaves, and cinnamon. Sauté for 30 seconds.
Add the marinated chicken and cook for 5 minutes. Add tomatoes and cook until the chicken is tender and the oil separates, about 15 minutes.
In another pot, bring water to a boil. Add salt and the drained rice. Cook until 70% done, about 5-7 minutes. Drain.
Layer the partially cooked rice over the chicken. Sprinkle the remaining biryani masala, mint leaves, cilantro, and fried onions. Pour the saffron milk over the top.
Cover with a tight-fitting lid and cook on low heat for 20 minutes until the rice is fully cooked and fragrant.
Gently mix the layers before serving.

name: Caprese Salad
description: A simple Italian salad made with fresh tomatoes, mozzarella, basil, and balsamic glaze.
ingredients: Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Arrange the tomato and mozzarella slices alternately on a serving platter.
Tuck fresh basil leaves between the tomato and mozzarella slices.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with sea salt and freshly ground black pepper.
Serve immediately at room temperature.

name: French Onion Soup
description: A classic French soup with caramelized onions, rich beef broth, and topped with melted cheese.
instructions: In a large pot, melt butter with olive oil over medium heat. Add onions and sugar. Cook, stirring occasionally, until onions are deeply caramelized, about 40-45 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute. Sprinkle in flour and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes.
Pour in wine and scrape up any brown bits from the bottom of the pot. Cook until wine is mostly evaporated.
Add beef broth, bay leaves, and thyme. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Preheat broiler. Ladle soup into oven-safe bowls placed on a baking sheet.
Top each bowl with a slice of baguette and generously sprinkle with grated Gruyère cheese.
Broil until cheese is melted and bubbly, about 2-3 minutes. Serve hot.

name: Lemon Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
description: A quick and delicious pasta dish with succulent shrimp in a lemon garlic butter sauce.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Cook pasta in salted water according to package instructions until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining.
Meanwhile, in a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of butter and olive oil over medium-high heat.
Season shrimp with salt and pepper. Add to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes per side until pink and cooked through. Remove shrimp and set aside.
In the same skillet, add remaining butter and garlic. Cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add red pepper flakes if using.
Pour in white wine, lemon juice, and zest. Simmer for 2 minutes.
Add the drained pasta to the skillet along with the cooked shrimp. Toss well to coat. If needed, add some reserved pasta water to loosen the sauce.
Remove from heat and stir in parsley and Parmesan cheese.
Serve immediately, garnished with extra Parmesan and lemon wedges if desired.

name: Vegetable Paella
description: A colorful and flavorful Spanish rice dish packed with vegetables and aromatic spices.
ingredients: 2 cups short-grain rice (like Bomba or Arborio)
1/2 tsp saffron threads, soaked in 2 tbsp hot water
Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large paella pan or wide, shallow skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook for another minute.
Add bell peppers and green beans. Cook for about 5 minutes until they begin to soften.
Stir in tomatoes, paprika, oregano, and rice. Cook for 2 minutes, stirring to coat the rice with oil.
Pour in vegetable broth and saffron with its soaking water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer.
Season with salt and pepper. Spread the rice evenly in the pan and do not stir from this point on.
Cook uncovered for about 15 minutes, until rice has absorbed most of the liquid but is still a bit wet.
Arrange artichoke hearts and sprinkle peas over the top. Continue to cook for another 10 minutes until rice is tender and has formed a slight crust on the bottom (called socarrat).
Remove from heat, cover with a cloth, and let rest for 5 minutes.
Garnish with parsley and lemon wedges before serving.

name: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
description: A quick Chinese-inspired stir-fry with tender beef slices and crisp broccoli in a savory sauce.
ingredients: 500g flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain
1 tbsp rice wine or dry sherry
1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
instructions: In a bowl, mix the marinade ingredients. Add beef slices, toss to coat, and let marinate for at least 10 minutes.
In another bowl, combine all sauce ingredients except the cornstarch slurry. Set aside.
Bring a pot of water to a boil. Blanch broccoli for 2 minutes, drain, and rinse with cold water to stop the cooking. Set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat. Add beef and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until browned but still slightly pink. Remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil to the wok. Add garlic and ginger, stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add broccoli and bell pepper, stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Return beef to the wok. Pour in the sauce and stir to combine.
Add the cornstarch slurry and cook, stirring constantly, until the sauce thickens, about 1-2 minutes.
Serve hot over steamed rice.

name: Classic Tiramisu
description: An elegant Italian dessert with layers of coffee-soaked ladyfingers and mascarpone cream.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, whisk together egg yolks and sugar until well blended. Whisk in milk and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture boils. Boil gently for 1 minute, remove from heat and allow to cool slightly. Cover tightly and chill in refrigerator for 1 hour.
In a medium bowl, beat cream with vanilla until stiff peaks form.
Whisk mascarpone into the yolk mixture until smooth.
Gently fold in the whipped cream into the mascarpone mixture.
In a small bowl, combine coffee and coffee liqueur. Dip the ladyfingers into the coffee mixture quickly (about 1 second per side) and arrange them in the bottom of a 9x13 inch dish.
Spread half of the mascarpone mixture over the ladyfingers. Repeat with another layer of dipped ladyfingers and the remaining mascarpone mixture.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight to allow the flavors to meld.
Before serving, dust with cocoa powder and garnish with chocolate shavings if desired.

name: Shakshuka
description: A Middle Eastern dish with eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large, deep skillet over medium heat. Add onion and bell peppers, cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic, cumin, paprika, and cayenne (if using). Cook for about 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in diced tomatoes and water. Stir and simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly. Season with salt and pepper.
Using a spoon, create 6 wells in the sauce for the eggs. Crack each egg into a well.
Cover the skillet and cook for 5-8 minutes, or until the egg whites are set but the yolks are still runny (or cook longer if you prefer firmer yolks).
Sprinkle with crumbled feta cheese, parsley, and cilantro.
Serve directly from the skillet with warm pita bread.

name: Vegetable Curry
description: A hearty and aromatic curry packed with nutritious vegetables in a rich coconut sauce.
ingredients: 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes (adjust to taste)
Cooked rice or naan bread for serving
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger, cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in curry powder, turmeric, cumin, coriander, and red pepper flakes. Cook for 30 seconds to bloom the spices.
Add diced tomatoes, coconut milk, and vegetable broth. Stir well.
Add carrots, potato, and sweet potato. Bring to a simmer and cook for 15 minutes.
Add bell pepper and cauliflower. Continue to simmer for 10 more minutes, or until all vegetables are tender.
Stir in green peas and cook for another 2 minutes.
Turn off the heat and add lime juice. Season with salt to taste.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with rice or naan bread.

name: Caesar Salad
description: A classic Caesar salad with crisp romaine lettuce, homemade croutons, and a creamy Caesar dressing.
ingredients: 2 large heads romaine lettuce, torn into bite-sized pieces
1/2 cup Parmesan cheese, freshly grated, plus more for garnish
Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: For homemade croutons: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Toss bread cubes with olive oil, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper. Spread on a baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes, or until golden and crisp. Set aside to cool.

For the dressing: In a bowl, whisk together garlic, anchovy (if using), egg yolk, lemon juice, and Dijon mustard. Slowly drizzle in olive oil while whisking continuously to emulsify. Stir in Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper.
In a large bowl, add romaine lettuce. Pour the dressing over the lettuce and toss well to coat.
Add croutons and grated Parmesan cheese. Toss gently to combine.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional Parmesan cheese and fresh black pepper.

name: Chicken Fajitas
description: Sizzling hot strips of marinated chicken with colorful bell peppers and onions, served with warm tortillas.
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken breasts, sliced into strips
Optional toppings: sour cream, guacamole, salsa, shredded cheese, cilantro
instructions: In a large bowl, combine lime juice, 1 tbsp olive oil, garlic, chili powder, cumin, paprika, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Add chicken strips to the marinade, toss to coat, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes (or up to 4 hours).
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over high heat. Add marinated chicken and cook for 5-6 minutes until browned and cooked through. Remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, add bell peppers and onions. Cook for 4-5 minutes until slightly charred but still crisp.
Return the chicken to the skillet and mix with the vegetables. Cook for another 2 minutes to combine flavors.
Warm tortillas according to package directions.
Serve the chicken and vegetable mixture with warm tortillas and optional toppings.

name: Banana Bread
description: Moist and delicious banana bread with a hint of cinnamon - perfect for using up overripe bananas.
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped walnuts or chocolate chips (optional)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease a 4x8 inch loaf pan.
In a large mixing bowl, mix mashed bananas with melted butter.
Mix in baking soda and salt. Stir in sugar, beaten egg, and vanilla extract.
Add the flour and cinnamon, mixing until just combined. Fold in walnuts or chocolate chips if using.
Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan and bake for about 55-60 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Let cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then remove to a wire rack to cool completely before slicing.

name: Beef Wellington
description: An elegant dish featuring beef tenderloin wrapped in puff pastry with mushroom duxelles and prosciutto.
instructions: Season beef tenderloin with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over high heat and sear the tenderloin on all sides until browned (about 2-3 minutes per side). Remove from pan and brush with Dijon mustard. Allow to cool completely.
In the same skillet, add mushrooms, shallots, garlic, and thyme. Cook until all moisture has evaporated (about 10 minutes). Season with salt and pepper, then set aside to cool.
Lay out plastic wrap and arrange prosciutto slices in a rectangle that's big enough to wrap around the beef. Spread the mushroom mixture over the prosciutto.

Place the cooled beef in the center and use the plastic wrap to tightly roll the prosciutto and mushroom mixture around the beef. Twist the ends of the plastic wrap to secure. Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a size that will wrap around the beef.
Unwrap the beef from the plastic and place in the center of the pastry. Fold the pastry over the beef and seal the edges. Trim any excess pastry.
Place the Wellington seam-side down on a baking sheet. Brush with beaten egg and score the top with a knife (do not cut all the way through).
Bake for 35-40 minutes until the pastry is golden brown and the beef reaches your desired doneness (130°F for medium-rare). Let rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

name: Pad Thai
description: A popular Thai street food dish with stir-fried rice noodles, eggs, tofu, bean sprouts, and peanuts in a flavorful sauce.
instructions: Soak rice noodles in hot water according to package directions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a small bowl, mix all sauce ingredients until sugar dissolves. Set aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat. Add beaten eggs and cook, stirring, until just set. Remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil to the wok. Add garlic and shallot, stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add tofu (or meat) and cook until lightly browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add drained noodles and sauce. Toss well to coat and cook for 2-3 minutes until noodles absorb the sauce.
Add cooked egg, bean sprouts, and half the green onions. Toss for another minute.
Serve hot, garnished with remaining green onions, crushed peanuts, fresh cilantro, and lime wedges.

name: Ratatouille
description: A classic French Provençal stewed vegetable dish with eggplant, zucchini, bell peppers, and tomatoes.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Place eggplant and zucchini on a baking sheet, drizzle with 2 tablespoons olive oil, and season with salt. Roast for 20 minutes until slightly softened.
Meanwhile, heat remaining oil in a large oven-safe skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onions and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add bell peppers and cook for another 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in tomatoes, tomato paste, thyme, oregano, bay leaf, salt, and pepper. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the roasted eggplant and zucchini to the skillet. Gently stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for 30-40 minutes until vegetables are tender and the sauce has thickened.
Remove bay leaf, stir in fresh basil, and allow to rest for 10 minutes before serving.

name: Cinnamon Rolls
description: Soft and fluffy homemade cinnamon rolls with a sweet cream cheese frosting.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine 2 cups of flour, sugar, salt, and yeast.
Add warm milk, melted butter, and eggs to the dry ingredients. Mix until well combined.
Gradually add remaining flour until a soft dough forms. Knead on a floured surface for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for about 1 hour or until doubled in size.
For the filling, mix brown sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl.
Punch down the dough and roll out on a floured surface to a 16x12 inch rectangle. Spread softened butter over the dough, then sprinkle evenly with the cinnamon-sugar mixture.
Roll up the dough tightly from the long edge. Cut into 12 equal slices.
Place rolls in a greased 9x13 inch baking pan. Cover and let rise for 30-40 minutes, or until nearly doubled.
Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden brown.
For the frosting, beat cream cheese and butter until light and fluffy. Add powdered sugar and vanilla, beat until smooth.
Spread frosting over warm rolls before serving.

name: Chicken Parmesan
description: Crispy breaded chicken cutlets topped with marinara sauce and melted cheese, served with pasta.
ingredients: 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese, plus more for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Place chicken breasts between sheets of plastic wrap and pound to an even 1/2-inch thickness. Season with salt and pepper.
Set up a breading station: Place flour in one dish, beaten eggs in a second dish, and combine breadcrumbs with Parmesan cheese in a third dish.
Dredge each chicken breast in flour, then dip in egg, and finally coat with the breadcrumb mixture, pressing to adhere.
Heat olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Pour marinara sauce around (not on top of) the chicken. Place mozzarella slices on top of each chicken breast.
Transfer skillet to the oven and bake until chicken is cooked through and cheese is melted and bubbly, about 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook pasta according to package directions. Drain.
Serve chicken over pasta, with additional sauce and Parmesan cheese. Garnish with fresh basil.

name: Fish Tacos
description: Light and flavorful tacos with crispy fish, cabbage slaw, and creamy sauce.
ingredients: 1 lb white fish fillets (like cod or tilapia)
1/2 cup sour cream or Greek yogurt
Toppings: avocado slices, lime wedges, salsa
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) or prepare a grill.
In a small bowl, mix chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Rub fish with olive oil, then coat with spice mixture.
If baking, place fish on a lined baking sheet and bake for 8-10 minutes until it flakes easily. If grilling, grill for 3-4 minutes per side.
While fish cooks, make the slaw by combining cabbage, cilantro, jalapeño, lime juice, and salt in a bowl.
For the sauce, whisk together sour cream, mayonnaise, lime juice, and hot sauce if using.
Warm tortillas according to package directions.
Flake the cooked fish into chunks. Assemble tacos by filling each tortilla with fish, topping with slaw, drizzling with sauce, and adding optional toppings.

name: Vegetable Lasagna
description: A hearty vegetarian lasagna packed with roasted vegetables, ricotta cheese, and flavorful tomato sauce.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss zucchini, eggplant, bell peppers, and onion with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread on baking sheets and roast for 20 minutes until tender and slightly caramelized.
Reduce oven temperature to 375°F (190°C).
Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions until al dente. Drain and lay flat on a clean kitchen towel.
In a bowl, combine ricotta, 1 cup mozzarella, 1/2 cup Parmesan, eggs, basil, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.

Spread 1/2 cup marinara sauce in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Layer 4 lasagna noodles, 1/3 of the cheese mixture, 1/3 of the roasted vegetables, and 1/2 cup marinara sauce. Repeat layers twice.
Top with remaining noodles, remaining sauce, and remaining mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses.
Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes. Remove foil and bake for another 15-20 minutes until bubbly and golden brown.
Let rest for 15 minutes before serving.

name: Chocolate Mousse
description: A rich and creamy chocolate dessert that's light, airy, and decadent.
instructions: Place chocolate and butter in a heatproof bowl set over a pot of simmering water (don't let the bowl touch the water). Stir until melted and smooth. Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
In a separate bowl, whip the egg whites with a pinch of salt until foamy. Gradually add half the sugar and continue whipping until stiff peaks form.
In another bowl, whip the heavy cream, remaining sugar, and vanilla until soft peaks form.
Stir the egg yolks into the cooled chocolate mixture until well combined.
Gently fold the whipped egg whites into the chocolate mixture, being careful not to deflate them. Then fold in the whipped cream.
Divide the mousse into 6 serving glasses or ramekins. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Before serving, garnish with chocolate shavings and fresh berries if desired.

name: Beef Stroganoff
description: A classic Russian dish of sautéed beef in a creamy mushroom sauce, served over egg noodles.
ingredients: 1 lb beef sirloin or tenderloin, cut into thin strips
instructions: Season beef strips with salt and pepper. Heat oil in a large skillet over high heat. Working in batches, add beef and cook until browned, about 1 minute per side. Remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add onions and cook until softened, about 3 minutes. Add mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and begin to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Sprinkle flour over the vegetables and stir to coat, cooking for 1 minute.
Slowly add beef broth, stirring constantly to avoid lumps. Stir in Dijon mustard and bring to a simmer. Cook until sauce thickens slightly, about 5 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and stir in sour cream until well combined. Do not boil after adding sour cream.
Return beef and any accumulated juices to the skillet. Cook gently until beef is heated through, about 2-3 minutes.
Serve over cooked egg noodles, garnished with fresh parsley.

name: Homemade Hummus
description: A smooth and creamy chickpea dip with tahini, lemon, and garlic - perfect for snacking or entertaining.
ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, plus more for serving
Paprika and chopped parsley for garnish
Vegetable sticks or pita bread for serving
instructions: In a food processor, combine chickpeas, lemon juice, tahini, garlic, olive oil, and cumin. Process until smooth.
With the machine running, add water one tablespoon at a time until you reach your desired consistency.
Taste and adjust seasonings, adding salt as needed.
Transfer to a serving bowl. Drizzle with additional olive oil and sprinkle with paprika and chopped parsley.
Serve with vegetable sticks or pita bread.

name: Pho - Vietnamese Noodle Soup
description: A fragrant and comforting Vietnamese soup with rice noodles, herbs, and your choice of protein.
ingredients: 1 lb rice noodles, cooked according to package directions
1 lb thinly sliced beef (sirloin, ribeye, or brisket) or chicken
Hoisin sauce and sriracha for serving
instructions: Char onions and ginger by placing them directly on a gas burner or under a broiler until blackened in spots, about 5 minutes. Rinse under cold water, removing any completely burnt parts.
In a large pot, dry toast star anise, cloves, cinnamon, cardamom, and coriander seeds over medium heat until fragrant, about 2-3 minutes.
Add charred onions, ginger, beef broth, fish sauce, and sugar. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer, partially covered, for at least 2.5 hours (the longer, the better).
Strain the broth through a fine-mesh sieve and return to the pot. Keep hot.
Prepare bowls by adding cooked rice noodles and placing thinly sliced raw beef or chicken on top (the hot broth will cook the meat).
Ladle the hot broth over the noodles and meat.
Serve with plates of bean sprouts, Thai basil, cilantro, lime wedges, and jalapeños, allowing everyone to garnish their own bowl.

name: Apple Pie
description: A classic American dessert with a flaky crust and sweet-tart apple filling, spiced with cinnamon.
ingredients: 6-7 large apples (mix of Granny Smith and sweeter varieties), peeled, cored, and sliced
instructions: For the crust: In a food processor, pulse flour, salt, and sugar to combine. Add cold butter and pulse until mixture resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces.
Sprinkle 6 tablespoons ice water over mixture and pulse until dough begins to form. If needed, add more water, 1 tablespoon at a time.
Divide dough in half, shape into disks, wrap in plastic, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
In a large bowl, combine sliced apples, sugar, flour, cinnamon, nutmeg, allspice, and lemon juice.
Roll out one disk of dough on a floured surface to a 12-inch circle. Transfer to a 9-inch pie dish.
Fill with apple mixture, mounding slightly in the center.
Roll out the second disk of dough and either place on top for a full cover or cut into strips for a lattice top. Seal and crimp edges.
If using a full top crust, cut several vents. Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
Bake for 20 minutes, then reduce temperature to 375°F (190°C) and bake for an additional 30-35 minutes until crust is golden and filling is bubbly.
Cool on a wire rack for at least 1 hour before serving.

name: Moussaka
description: A hearty Greek casserole with layers of eggplant, potatoes, spiced meat, and creamy béchamel sauce.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Season eggplant slices with salt and let sit for 30 minutes to draw out moisture. Pat dry with paper towels.
Brush eggplant and potato slices with olive oil and place on baking sheets. Bake for 20 minutes until softened and lightly browned. Reduce oven to 350°F (175°C).
For the meat sauce: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion and cook until soft, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds.

Add ground meat and cook, breaking it up, until browned. Add tomatoes, tomato paste, cinnamon, allspice, cloves, oregano, wine, salt, and pepper. Simmer for 15-20 minutes until thickened. Stir in parsley.

For the béchamel: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes. Gradually whisk in warm milk and cook, stirring constantly, until thickened. Remove from heat and stir in nutmeg. Beat egg yolks in a small bowl, then gradually whisk in some of the hot sauce to temper. Return this mixture to the pot and stir to combine.
To assemble: In a 9x13 inch baking dish, layer potatoes, then half the eggplant, then all of the meat sauce, then remaining eggplant. Pour béchamel over the top and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake for 45 minutes until golden brown and bubbly. Let rest for 15 minutes before serving.

name: Falafel
description: Crispy Middle Eastern chickpea fritters, perfect in pita bread with fresh vegetables and tahini sauce.
ingredients: 2 cups dried chickpeas, soaked overnight (do not use canned)
instructions: Drain soaked chickpeas well. Place in a food processor with onion, garlic, parsley, and cilantro. Pulse until finely minced but not pureed.
Transfer to a bowl and add cumin, coriander, cayenne (if using), baking powder, lemon juice, and salt. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to overnight.
Form the mixture into balls or patties about 2 inches in diameter and 1/2 inch thick.
Heat 3 inches of oil in a deep pot to 350°F (175°C).
Fry the falafel in batches, turning occasionally, until deeply browned and crisp, about 3-4 minutes per batch. Drain on paper towels.
Serve hot in pita bread with tahini sauce and fresh vegetables.

name: Lemon Meringue Pie
description: A classic dessert with a crisp pastry crust, tangy lemon filling, and fluffy meringue topping.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).

For the crust: In a food processor, pulse flour and salt. Add butter and pulse until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add ice water 1 tablespoon at a time, pulsing until dough comes together. Form into a disk, wrap, and chill for 30 minutes.

Roll out dough on a floured surface and place in a 9-inch pie dish. Trim and crimp edges. Prick bottom with a fork, line with parchment, and fill with pie weights or dried beans. Bake for 15 minutes. Remove weights and parchment and bake for another 5-7 minutes until lightly golden. Cool.

For the filling: In a medium saucepan, whisk together sugar, flour, cornstarch, and salt. Gradually add water, whisking constantly. Cook over medium-high heat, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil and thickens.

Remove from heat and stir in butter and lemon zest. Temper the egg yolks by slowly adding some of the hot mixture while whisking constantly. Return everything to the saucepan and bring to a gentle boil, stirring constantly. Cook for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in lemon juice. Pour into pre-baked crust.
For the meringue: In a clean bowl, beat egg whites and cream of tartar until foamy. Gradually add sugar and continue beating until stiff, glossy peaks form. Beat in vanilla.
Spread meringue over hot filling, sealing all the way to the crust edges. Create peaks with the back of a spoon.
Bake for 10-12 minutes until meringue is golden. Cool completely on a wire rack, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.

name: Chicken Teriyaki
description: Tender chicken glazed with a sweet and savory teriyaki sauce, served with steamed rice.
ingredients: 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine soy sauce, mirin, sake, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger. Bring to a simmer over medium heat and cook for 5 minutes.
Reserve 1/2 cup of the sauce for later. Pour the remaining sauce over the chicken in a shallow dish or zip-top bag. Marinate for at least 30 minutes (or up to overnight in the refrigerator).
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Remove chicken from marinade (discard used marinade) and cook for 5-7 minutes per side until cooked through and nicely browned.
While chicken cooks, bring reserved sauce to a simmer in a small saucepan. Add cornstarch slurry and cook, stirring constantly, until sauce thickens, about 1-2 minutes.
Slice chicken and serve over steamed rice. Drizzle with thickened teriyaki sauce and garnish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds.

name: Spanish Paella with Seafood
description: A traditional Spanish rice dish with saffron, vegetables, and a variety of seafood.
ingredients: 2 cups short-grain rice (such as Bomba or Arborio)
1/2 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: In a small bowl, steep saffron threads in 1/4 cup hot stock for 10 minutes.
Heat olive oil in a large paella pan or wide, shallow skillet over medium heat. Add onion and cook until soft, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and bell pepper, cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Add tomatoes and paprika, cook for 2-3 minutes until tomatoes break down slightly.
Add rice and stir to coat with oil and vegetables. Pour in the remaining stock and saffron-infused liquid. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer. Season with salt and pepper.
Spread the rice evenly in the pan and do not stir from this point on. Cook uncovered for about 15 minutes, until rice has absorbed most of the liquid but is still not fully cooked.

Arrange the seafood on top of the rice, starting with the items that take longer to cook. Begin with squid rings, then shrimp, and finally mussels and clams (hinge side down so they can open as they cook).
Sprinkle peas over the top. Continue to cook for another 10 minutes until rice is tender and all the seafood is cooked (mussels and clams should open).
Remove from heat, cover with a cloth, and let rest for 5 minutes.
Garnish with lemon wedges and chopped parsley before serving.

name: Homemade Pizza
description: Fresh pizza with a crispy crust, tangy tomato sauce, melty cheese, and your favorite toppings.
ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, plus more for coating
instructions: For the dough: In a large bowl, combine 1 cup flour, sugar, yeast, and salt. Add warm water and 2 tablespoons olive oil. Mix until smooth. Gradually add remaining flour until a soft dough forms.
Turn dough onto a floured surface and knead for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic. Place in an oiled bowl, turning to coat. Cover and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until doubled in size.

Meanwhile, make the sauce: In a saucepan, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add crushed tomatoes, oregano, basil, salt, and red pepper flakes if using. Simmer for 15 minutes. Cool slightly.
Preheat oven to 475°F (245°C). If using a pizza stone, place it in the oven while preheating.
Once dough has risen, punch down and divide into two balls (for two 12-inch pizzas). On a floured surface, roll or stretch each ball into a 12-inch circle.
If using a pizza stone, place the dough on a floured pizza peel. Otherwise, place on a greased baking sheet.
Spread sauce over the dough, leaving a 1/2-inch border. Sprinkle with mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses. Add desired toppings.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until crust is golden and cheese is bubbly and lightly browned.
Remove from oven, garnish with fresh basil leaves, and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing.

name: Mango Sticky Rice
description: A popular Thai dessert made with glutinous rice, fresh mango, and sweetened coconut milk.
ingredients: 1 tbsp toasted sesame seeds or mung beans (optional)
instructions: Rinse the glutinous rice several times in cold water until the water runs clear. Soak in water for at least 1 hour or up to overnight.
Drain the soaked rice. Place in a steamer lined with cheesecloth or a bamboo steamer. Steam for 20-25 minutes until the rice is translucent and tender.
While the rice is cooking, heat 1 cup of coconut milk, 1/4 cup sugar, and salt in a small saucepan over low heat, stirring until sugar dissolves. Do not boil. Set aside.

In another small saucepan, heat the remaining coconut milk and 2 tablespoons sugar until sugar dissolves. Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 3-5 minutes until slightly thickened. This will be your coconut sauce for serving.
When rice is done, transfer to a bowl and pour the first coconut milk mixture over it. Stir gently to combine. Cover and let sit for 30 minutes to absorb the coconut milk.
To serve, place a portion of sticky rice on a plate, arrange mango slices alongside, and drizzle with the thickened coconut sauce. Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds or mung beans if desired.

name: Beef Bourguignon
description: A classic French stew with beef braised in red wine, garnished with mushrooms, bacon, and onions.
ingredients: 3 lbs beef chuck, cut into 2-inch cubes
1 bottle (750 ml) dry red wine (preferably Burgundy)
1 bouquet garni (bundle of thyme, parsley, and bay leaf)
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F (165°C).
Season beef with salt and pepper. In a large Dutch oven, cook bacon over medium heat until crisp. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside, leaving the fat in the pot.
Working in batches, brown the beef on all sides in the bacon fat, about 3-4 minutes per batch. Transfer to a plate.
Add carrots, onion, and celery to the pot. Cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add beef back to the pot along with bacon. Add wine, beef stock, tomato paste, and bouquet garni. Bring to a simmer.
Cover and transfer to the oven. Cook for 2 1/2 hours, or until beef is very tender.
About 30 minutes before the stew is done, heat 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add mushrooms and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Set aside.
In the same skillet, heat another tablespoon of butter. Add pearl onions and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Set aside with mushrooms.
When beef is tender, remove the pot from the oven. Skim off any excess fat from the surface.
In a small bowl, mash together remaining tablespoon of butter with flour to form a paste (beurre manié). Stir this into the stew to thicken the sauce.
Add the mushrooms and pearl onions. Simmer on the stovetop for 10 minutes, until sauce thickens.
Remove bouquet garni. Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve garnished with fresh parsley.

name: Chicken Enchiladas
description: Rolled tortillas filled with seasoned chicken and cheese, topped with enchilada sauce and baked until bubbly.
ingredients: 2 cups shredded Mexican cheese blend, divided
For garnish: sour cream, sliced avocado, chopped cilantro, diced tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium heat. Add onion and cook until soft, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and jalapeño (if using) and cook for 1 minute.
Add shredded chicken, cumin, chili powder, oregano, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine. Add 1/4 cup of enchilada sauce and simmer for 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
In a separate small skillet, heat remaining oil. Dip each tortilla in oil for a few seconds on each side to soften (this prevents cracking). Drain on paper towels.
Pour 1/2 cup enchilada sauce in the bottom of the prepared baking dish.
Fill each tortilla with about 2 tablespoons of the chicken mixture and 1 tablespoon of cheese. Roll up and place seam side down in the baking dish.
Pour remaining enchilada sauce over the rolled tortillas and sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until the sauce is bubbly and cheese is melted and lightly browned.
Let stand for 5 minutes before serving. Garnish with sour cream, avocado, cilantro, and tomatoes.

name: Tomato Basil Soup
description: A comforting soup made with ripe tomatoes, fresh basil, and a touch of cream.
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe tomatoes, chopped (or 2 28-oz cans whole peeled tomatoes)
1/4 cup fresh basil leaves, plus more for garnish
Croutons or grilled cheese sandwiches for serving (optional)
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook until soft and translucent, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Add tomato paste and cook, stirring, for 1-2 minutes until it darkens slightly.
Add chopped tomatoes, broth, basil, sugar, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer, partially covered, for about 30-40 minutes.
Using an immersion blender, blend the soup until smooth. Alternatively, let the soup cool slightly and blend in batches in a regular blender.
Return soup to the pot (if using a regular blender) and stir in cream if using. Warm gently over low heat.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with additional fresh basil leaves and accompanied by croutons or grilled cheese sandwiches if desired.

name: Lemon Garlic Roast Chicken
description: A juicy whole roasted chicken infused with lemon, garlic, and herbs.
ingredients: Optional vegetables for roasting: carrots, onions, potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Remove giblets from chicken cavity and pat chicken dry with paper towels inside and out.
Zest one lemon and combine zest with softened butter, thyme, rosemary, salt, and pepper.
Cut both lemons in half. Squeeze the juice from one lemon into a small bowl and reserve.
Carefully loosen the skin over the chicken breast and thighs. Rub about two-thirds of the herb butter mixture under the skin, directly onto the meat.
Rub the remaining butter mixture all over the outside of the chicken. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with additional salt and pepper.
Place the squeezed lemon halves, the remaining whole lemon halves, and the halved head of garlic inside the chicken cavity.
If using vegetables, toss them with olive oil, salt, and pepper and arrange around the chicken in a roasting pan.

Pour chicken broth into the bottom of the pan. Roast for about 1 hour and 20 minutes, or until an instant-read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the thigh registers 165°F (74°C) and juices run clear.
During cooking, baste the chicken with pan juices several times. If the skin is browning too quickly, cover loosely with foil.
Let the chicken rest for 15 minutes before carving. Drizzle with reserved lemon juice before serving.

name: Mushroom Risotto
description: A creamy Italian rice dish with earthy mushrooms, white wine, and Parmesan cheese.
ingredients: 6 cups chicken or vegetable broth, kept warm
1 lb mixed mushrooms (cremini, shiitake, oyster), sliced
1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese, plus more for serving
instructions: In a large pot, heat the broth over low heat to keep warm throughout the cooking process.

In a large, heavy-bottomed pan, heat 2 tablespoons olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter over medium-high heat. Add mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and become golden, about 8 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, heat the remaining tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat. Add onion and cook until soft and translucent, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Add the Arborio rice and stir to coat with oil, toasting for about 2 minutes until the edges become translucent.
Add the white wine and stir constantly until it is mostly absorbed.
Begin adding the warm broth, one ladle at a time, stirring frequently. Wait until each addition is nearly absorbed before adding the next. This process should take about 20-25 minutes.
When the rice is creamy and al dente (tender but with a slight bite), stir in the reserved mushrooms, remaining 2 tablespoons of butter, and Parmesan cheese. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Remove from heat and let stand for 2 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley and serve with additional Parmesan cheese.

name: Pumpkin Spice Muffins
description: Moist and flavorful muffins filled with pumpkin purée and warm autumn spices.
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped nuts or chocolate chips (optional)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners or grease with cooking spray.
In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, cloves, and salt.
In a large bowl, whisk together granulated sugar, brown sugar, and oil until combined. Add eggs one at a time, whisking well after each addition.
Stir in pumpkin purée, milk, and vanilla extract until smooth.
Fold the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients until just combined. Do not overmix. Fold in nuts or chocolate chips if using.
Divide the batter evenly among the muffin cups, filling each about 3/4 full.
If using the topping, mix sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl and sprinkle over the muffin batter.
Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of a muffin comes out clean.
Allow to cool in the pan for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

name: Tandoori Chicken
description: Spicy and aromatic Indian-style chicken marinated in yogurt and spices, then roasted to perfection.
ingredients: 8 chicken pieces (thighs and drumsticks), skin removed
instructions: Make small cuts in the chicken pieces to allow the marinade to penetrate.
In a large bowl, combine yogurt, lemon juice, oil, garlic, ginger, tandoori masala, cumin, coriander, paprika, turmeric, cayenne pepper, and salt. Mix well.
Add chicken pieces and coat thoroughly with the marinade. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight.
Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a baking sheet with foil and place a wire rack on top.
Remove chicken from marinade, shaking off excess. Place on the prepared rack.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, turning once halfway through, until chicken is cooked through and has reached an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
For extra color, broil for the last 3-5 minutes until slightly charred in spots.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving with lemon wedges, cilantro, sliced red onion, and naan bread.

name: Vegetable Stir Fry
description: A quick and colorful medley of fresh vegetables in a flavorful Asian-inspired sauce.
ingredients: 1 tsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together all sauce ingredients except the cornstarch slurry. Set aside.
Heat oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat. Add garlic and ginger, stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.

Add vegetables in order of cooking time: first carrots and broccoli for 2 minutes, then bell peppers and mushrooms for 2 minutes, and finally snow peas, water chestnuts, and green onions for 1 minute. Stir-fry until vegetables are crisp-tender.
Pour the sauce over the vegetables and toss to coat. Add the cornstarch slurry and stir until the sauce thickens, about 1 minute.
Serve hot over rice or noodles, garnished with sesame seeds and cilantro if desired.

name: Classic Cheesecake
description: A rich and creamy New York-style cheesecake with a graham cracker crust.
ingredients: 4 packages (8 oz each) cream cheese, room temperature
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F (165°C). Grease a 9-inch springform pan and wrap the outside with aluminum foil to prevent leaking.

For the crust: In a medium bowl, combine graham cracker crumbs, sugar, and melted butter. Press firmly into the bottom and about 1 inch up the sides of the prepared pan. Bake for 10 minutes. Cool while preparing the filling.
Reduce oven temperature to 300°F (150°C).
For the filling: In a large bowl, beat cream cheese with an electric mixer until smooth and creamy, about 2 minutes. Add sugar and beat until well combined.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. Stir in sour cream and vanilla. Add flour and mix until just incorporated. Do not overmix.

Pour filling over the pre-baked crust. Place the foil-wrapped springform pan in a larger roasting pan. Fill the roasting pan with enough hot water to come halfway up the sides of the springform pan (water bath method).
Bake for 1 hour to 1 hour 10 minutes, or until the center is almost set but still slightly jiggly.
Turn off the oven, crack the door open, and let the cheesecake cool in the oven for 1 hour.
Remove from the oven and water bath. Run a knife around the edge of the pan to loosen the cheesecake. Cool completely on a wire rack.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours or overnight before serving.
Top with fresh berries, berry sauce, or whipped cream if desired.

name: Butternut Squash Soup
description: A smooth and creamy soup made with roasted butternut squash, warm spices, and a hint of apple.
ingredients: 1 large butternut squash (about 3 lbs), peeled, seeded, and cubed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss butternut squash cubes with 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet. Roast for 25-30 minutes until tender and slightly caramelized.
Meanwhile, heat the remaining tablespoon of olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and carrots, cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add apples, garlic, and ginger. Cook for another 3 minutes.
Add roasted butternut squash, broth, cinnamon, nutmeg, and cloves. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly. Using an immersion blender, purée the soup until smooth. Alternatively, carefully transfer the soup in batches to a blender.
Return soup to the pot over low heat. If using, stir in heavy cream. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with toasted pumpkin seeds and chopped chives.

name: Beef Tacos
description: Classic Mexican tacos with seasoned ground beef, fresh toppings, and warm tortillas.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until no longer pink, about 5-7 minutes.
Add onion and garlic to the beef. Cook until onion is soft, about 3 minutes.
Drain excess fat if needed. Add taco seasoning and water. Stir well and simmer until liquid is reduced and mixture has thickened, about 3-5 minutes.
Meanwhile, warm tortillas according to package directions or directly over a gas flame for about 30 seconds per side.
To serve, place a spoonful of the beef mixture in the center of each tortilla. Top with desired toppings.
Serve immediately with lime wedges on the side.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
description: A quick and luxurious pasta dish with succulent shrimp in a rich garlic butter sauce.
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese, plus more for serving
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of salted water according to package directions until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining.
While pasta cooks, season shrimp with salt and pepper.
In a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium-high heat. Add shrimp and cook for 1-2 minutes per side until pink and just cooked through. Remove to a plate.
In the same skillet, add remaining butter. Once melted, add garlic and red pepper flakes if using. Cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add white wine and lemon juice, simmer for 2 minutes to reduce slightly.
Return shrimp to the skillet along with the drained pasta, parsley, and Parmesan cheese. Toss to combine. If the sauce seems too thick, add a splash of the reserved pasta water.
Season with additional salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional Parmesan cheese.

name: Vegetable Samosas
description: Crispy Indian pastries filled with spiced potatoes, peas, and fragrant spices.
ingredients: 3 medium potatoes, boiled, peeled, and diced
instructions: For the dough: In a large bowl, mix flour and salt. Add oil and rub into the flour until it resembles breadcrumbs. Gradually add water, kneading to form a firm dough. Cover with a damp cloth and let rest for 30 minutes.
For the filling: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Add cumin seeds and let them splutter. Add onion, garlic, ginger, and green chili if using. Sauté until onion is golden brown.
Add ground coriander, cumin, turmeric, and garam masala. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add diced potatoes and peas. Mix well to coat with spices. Cook for 3-4 minutes, mashing slightly but leaving some texture. Add salt to taste.
Remove from heat and stir in fresh cilantro. Let cool completely.
Divide the dough into 12 equal portions. Roll each portion into a circle about 6 inches in diameter. Cut each circle in half.
Take one half-circle, moisten the straight edge with water, and form a cone by bringing the two ends together, overlapping slightly, and pressing to seal.
Fill the cone with about 2 tablespoons of the potato filling. Moisten the top edge with water, then press to seal, creating a triangular shape. Repeat with remaining dough and filling.
Heat oil for deep frying to 350°F (175°C). Fry samosas in batches until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per batch. Drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with mint chutney.

name: Bruschetta
description: A simple Italian appetizer with toasted bread topped with fresh tomatoes, basil, and garlic.
ingredients: 3 cloves garlic, minced (plus 1 whole clove for rubbing bread)
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, plus more for brushing
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) or preheat a grill.
Brush bread slices with olive oil on both sides. Place on a baking sheet and bake for 5-7 minutes until golden and crisp, or grill until lightly charred on both sides.
Cut the whole garlic clove in half and rub the cut side over one side of each toasted bread slice.
In a medium bowl, combine diced tomatoes, minced garlic, basil, olive oil, and balsamic vinegar. Season with salt and pepper. Let sit for at least 10 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Top each bread slice with the tomato mixture. If desired, sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese.
Serve immediately so the bread stays crisp.

name: Chicken Alfredo
description: Creamy pasta with tender chicken and a rich, cheesy Alfredo sauce.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions until al dente. Drain and set aside.

Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper on both sides. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook for 5-7 minutes per side until cooked through. Remove from pan, let rest for 5 minutes, then slice into strips.
In the same skillet, reduce heat to medium-low. Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add heavy cream and butter. Simmer gently until butter is melted and mixture begins to thicken slightly, about 3-4 minutes.
Gradually whisk in Parmesan cheese until melted and sauce is smooth. Add nutmeg, salt, and pepper to taste.
Add cooked pasta to the sauce and toss to coat. Add sliced chicken and toss gently to combine, adding a little pasta water if the sauce is too thick.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional Parmesan cheese and chopped parsley.

name: Peanut Butter Cookies
description: Classic, soft and chewy peanut butter cookies with the traditional crisscross pattern.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, cream together butter, peanut butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes.
Beat in eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the peanut butter mixture, mixing until just combined.
Roll dough into 1-inch balls and place 2 inches apart on prepared baking sheets.
Using a fork, create a crisscross pattern on each cookie, gently flattening them.
Bake for 9-10 minutes until edges are lightly golden. Do not overbake if you want soft cookies.
Let cool on baking sheets for 5 minutes, then transfer to wire racks to cool completely.

name: Gazpacho
description: A refreshing Spanish cold soup made with raw, blended vegetables, perfect for hot summer days.
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, seeded and roughly chopped
1/4 cup olive oil, plus more for drizzling
1 slice day-old bread, crusts removed, soaked in water and squeezed dry
instructions: Reserve about 1/4 cup each of diced tomato, cucumber, and bell pepper for garnish.
In a blender or food processor, combine the remaining tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper, red onion, garlic, olive oil, vinegar, soaked bread, and cumin. Blend until smooth.
If a smoother texture is desired, pass the soup through a fine-mesh sieve.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight to allow flavors to develop.
Before serving, taste and adjust seasoning if needed.
Serve cold, garnished with the reserved diced vegetables, a drizzle of olive oil, and croutons if desired.

name: Chicken Pot Pie
description: A comforting classic with a flaky crust covering a creamy filling of chicken and vegetables.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Place one pie crust in the bottom of a 9-inch pie dish.
In a large saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Add onion and cook until soft, about 3 minutes.
Stir in flour, salt, and pepper until well blended. Gradually stir in chicken broth and milk, cooking and stirring until thickened and bubbly.
Add chicken, peas, carrots, and celery. Remove from heat.
Pour the filling into the pie crust-lined dish. Top with the second crust, seal the edges, and trim excess dough. Cut slits in the top crust for steam to escape.
Brush the top crust with beaten egg for a golden finish.
Bake for 30-35 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbly. If the crust begins to brown too quickly, cover the edges with aluminum foil.
Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

name: Eggplant Parmesan
description: Layers of breaded and fried eggplant, marinara sauce, and cheese, baked until bubbly and golden.
ingredients: 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese, plus more for layers
1 lb mozzarella cheese, sliced or shredded
instructions: Sprinkle eggplant slices with salt and place in a colander. Let sit for 30 minutes to draw out moisture. Rinse and pat dry with paper towels.
Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Set up a breading station: Put flour in one dish, beaten eggs in a second dish, and mix breadcrumbs with 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese in a third dish.
Dredge each eggplant slice in flour, then dip in egg, and finally coat with the breadcrumb mixture.
Heat 1/4 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Working in batches, fry eggplant slices until golden brown, about 2 minutes per side. Drain on paper towels.
Spread 1 cup of marinara sauce in the bottom of the prepared baking dish. Arrange a layer of eggplant slices over the sauce, slightly overlapping.
Top with 1 cup of marinara sauce, 1/3 of the mozzarella cheese, and a sprinkle of Parmesan cheese.
Repeat layers twice more, ending with cheese on top.
Bake uncovered for 35-40 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly, and the edges are golden brown.
Let stand for 10 minutes before serving. Sprinkle with fresh basil and red pepper flakes if desired.

name: Lamb Kofta
description: Spiced ground lamb skewers, grilled to perfection and served with tzatziki sauce.
ingredients: 1 tbsp fresh mint or dill, chopped
instructions: For the kofta: In a large bowl, combine ground lamb, grated onion, garlic, parsley, mint, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, allspice, cayenne (if using), salt, and pepper. Mix well with your hands until thoroughly combined.
Divide the mixture into 8 equal portions. Shape each portion around a skewer, forming an elongated sausage shape about 4 inches long. If not using skewers, form into oblong patties.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to firm up.
For the tzatziki: In a medium bowl, combine Greek yogurt, grated cucumber, garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, mint or dill, salt, and pepper. Stir well and refrigerate until ready to serve.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat or heat a grill pan over medium-high heat.
Grill kofta for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through but still juicy.
Serve hot with tzatziki sauce, warm pita bread, tomato slices, red onion, and fresh herbs.

name: Ratatouille
description: A classic French Provençal stewed vegetable dish with eggplant, zucchini, bell peppers, and tomatoes.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Place eggplant and zucchini on a baking sheet, drizzle with 2 tablespoons olive oil, and season with salt. Roast for 20 minutes until slightly softened.
Meanwhile, heat remaining oil in a large oven-safe skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onions and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add bell peppers and cook for another 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in tomatoes, tomato paste, thyme, oregano, bay leaf, salt, and pepper. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the roasted eggplant and zucchini to the skillet. Gently stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for 30-40 minutes until vegetables are tender and the sauce has thickened.
Remove bay leaf, stir in fresh basil, and allow to rest for 10 minutes before serving.

name: Baklava
description: A rich, sweet pastry made of layers of filo filled with chopped nuts and sweetened with honey or syrup.
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F (165°C). Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a food processor, pulse walnuts and pistachios until coarsely chopped. Transfer to a bowl and mix with sugar, cinnamon, and cloves.
Unroll phyllo dough and trim to fit the baking dish if necessary. Cover with a damp cloth to prevent drying.
Place 2 sheets of phyllo in the prepared baking dish and brush generously with melted butter. Repeat until you have used 8 sheets.
Sprinkle 1/3 of the nut mixture evenly over the phyllo.
Layer 2 more sheets of phyllo, brushing each with butter, and repeat until you have used 4 sheets. Sprinkle with another 1/3 of the nut mixture.
Repeat step 6 once more.
Top with 8-10 sheets of phyllo, brushing each with butter, including the top layer.
Using a sharp knife, cut the baklava into diamond or square shapes, cutting all the way to the bottom of the dish.
Bake for 50-60 minutes until golden brown and crisp.

While the baklava is baking, make the syrup: Combine water, sugar, honey, cinnamon stick, cloves, and lemon zest in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove from heat, discard cinnamon stick, cloves, and lemon zest. Stir in lemon juice and cool to room temperature.
Immediately after removing the baklava from the oven, pour the cooled syrup evenly over the hot pastry.
Let cool completely, uncovered, at room temperature for at least 4 hours or overnight before serving.

name: Shrimp Scampi
description: Succulent shrimp sautéed in a garlic butter white wine sauce, served over pasta.
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of salted water according to package directions until al dente. Drain, reserving 1/2 cup pasta water.
Meanwhile, in a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons butter and 2 tablespoons olive oil over medium-high heat.
Season shrimp with salt and pepper. Once the butter is melted and hot, add shrimp in a single layer. Cook for 1-2 minutes per side until pink and just cooked through. Remove to a plate.
In the same skillet, add remaining butter and oil. Add garlic and red pepper flakes if using. Cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add white wine and lemon juice. Bring to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes to reduce slightly.
Return shrimp to the skillet, along with any accumulated juices. Add lemon zest and parsley. Toss to coat.
Add drained pasta to the skillet and toss to combine. If the sauce seems too thick, add a splash of the reserved pasta water.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley and Parmesan cheese if desired.

name: Chicken Marsala
description: An Italian-American dish of chicken cutlets, mushrooms, and Marsala wine sauce.
ingredients: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, pounded thin
Cooked pasta or mashed potatoes for serving
instructions: In a shallow dish, combine flour, salt, and pepper. Dredge chicken breasts in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
In the same skillet, melt butter. Add mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and begin to brown, about 5-7 minutes.
Add garlic and shallot, cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in Marsala wine, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Simmer for 2-3 minutes until reduced by half.
Add chicken broth and bring to a simmer. Return chicken to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes until chicken is cooked through and sauce has thickened slightly.
Stir in heavy cream and parsley. Season with additional salt and pepper if needed.
Serve over pasta or mashed potatoes.

name: Baba Ganoush
description: A creamy Middle Eastern dip made from roasted eggplant, tahini, and spices.
ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, plus more for drizzling
1/4 tsp smoked paprika, plus more for garnish
Pita bread or vegetables for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C). Line a baking sheet with foil.
Prick eggplants all over with a fork. Place on prepared baking sheet and roast for about 45 minutes, turning occasionally, until the skin is charred and the flesh is very soft.
Let eggplants cool slightly, then cut them in half lengthwise. Scoop out the flesh and place in a colander to drain for 10 minutes.
Transfer eggplant to a food processor. Add tahini, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, cumin, and smoked paprika. Process until smooth.
Season with salt to taste. If the mixture is too thick, add a tablespoon of water or more lemon juice.
Transfer to a serving bowl. Create a shallow well in the center and drizzle with olive oil. Sprinkle with smoked paprika and chopped parsley.
Serve at room temperature with warm pita bread or fresh vegetables.

name: Coconut Curry Chicken
description: A fragrant and creamy curry with tender chicken pieces in a coconut milk sauce.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or pot over medium-high heat. Add chicken pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes. Remove and set aside.
In the same pot, add onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes. Add garlic and ginger, cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in curry powder, turmeric, cumin, and cayenne pepper if using. Cook for 30 seconds to bloom the spices.
Add coconut milk, chicken broth, and tomato paste. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Return chicken to the pot. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add bell pepper and cook for 5 minutes more.
Stir in frozen peas and cook until heated through, about 2 minutes.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve over rice, garnished with fresh cilantro and lime wedges on the side.

name: Lentil Soup
description: A hearty and nutritious soup with lentils, vegetables, and aromatic spices.
ingredients: 2 cups dried green or brown lentils, rinsed and picked over
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion, carrots, and celery. Cook until vegetables are softened, about 5-7 minutes.
Add garlic, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and red pepper flakes if using. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add lentils, diced tomatoes with their juice, bay leaf, and broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 30-35 minutes, until lentils are tender.
If using spinach, stir it in and cook for 2-3 minutes until wilted.
Remove bay leaf. Stir in lemon juice and season with salt and pepper to taste.
For a creamier texture, blend a portion of the soup with an immersion blender, or carefully transfer about 2 cups to a blender, purée, and return to the pot.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley.

name: Chocolate Lava Cake
description: Decadent individual chocolate cakes with a warm, flowing chocolate center.
ingredients: Butter and cocoa powder for greasing ramekins
Vanilla ice cream or whipped cream for serving (optional)
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Butter four 6-oz ramekins and dust with cocoa powder, tapping out excess.
In a microwave-safe bowl, combine chocolate and butter. Microwave in 30-second intervals, stirring between each, until melted and smooth.
Whisk in powdered sugar until well combined.
Add eggs and egg yolks, one at a time, whisking well after each addition. Stir in vanilla extract.
Fold in flour and salt until just combined. Do not overmix.
Divide batter evenly among prepared ramekins. Place ramekins on a baking sheet.
Bake for 12-14 minutes until the edges are set but the center is still soft. The tops should be firm to the touch but will spring back slightly.
Let stand for 1 minute, then run a knife around the edges to loosen.
Carefully invert each cake onto a serving plate. Let stand for 10 seconds, then lift the ramekin.
Serve immediately with ice cream or whipped cream and fresh berries if desired.

name: Gnocchi with Sage Butter Sauce
description: Soft potato dumplings tossed in a simple, aromatic sage-infused brown butter sauce.
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting
1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese, plus more for serving
instructions: For the gnocchi: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Pierce potatoes several times with a fork and place directly on the oven rack. Bake until tender, about 45-60 minutes.
Cut potatoes in half and scoop out the flesh while still hot. Pass through a potato ricer or mash very finely.
Spread the potatoes on a work surface and let cool slightly. Sprinkle with flour, salt, and pour the beaten egg over the top.
Gently mix and knead until a soft dough forms, being careful not to overwork. Add more flour if the dough is too sticky.
Divide the dough into 4 pieces. Roll each piece into a rope about 1/2 inch thick. Cut into 1-inch pieces.
Optional: Roll each piece over the tines of a fork to create ridges, which help hold the sauce.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
For the sauce: In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add sage leaves and cook until butter begins to brown and sage becomes crisp, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
Cook gnocchi in the boiling water until they float to the surface, about 2-3 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer gnocchi directly to the skillet with the sage butter.
Return skillet to low heat and toss gnocchi to coat with the butter sauce. Add Parmesan cheese, salt, pepper, and nutmeg if using.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional Parmesan cheese and crispy sage leaves.

name: Butter Chicken
description: Tender chicken in a rich, creamy tomato sauce flavored with aromatic Indian spices.
ingredients: 800g boneless chicken thighs, cut into chunks
instructions: In a bowl, mix yogurt, lemon juice, half of the cumin, coriander, turmeric, garam masala, chili powder, and salt. Add chicken and marinate for at least 2 hours, preferably overnight.
Heat oil and butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add cinnamon stick and cardamom pods, sauté for 30 seconds.
Add onions and cook until golden brown, about 8 minutes. Add garlic, ginger, and green chilies, cook for 2 more minutes.
Stir in remaining spices and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add tomato puree, bring to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes until sauce thickens.
In a separate pan, cook the marinated chicken until browned and cooked through, about 8-10 minutes.
Add the cooked chicken to the sauce. Pour in cream and add sugar. Simmer for 5-10 minutes.
Crush dried fenugreek leaves between your palms and add to the curry. Adjust salt and sugar to taste.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with naan or rice.

name: Palak Paneer
description: Creamy spinach curry with chunks of paneer cheese, a vegetarian North Indian favorite.
instructions: Blanch spinach in boiling water for 2-3 minutes. Drain and transfer to ice water to stop the cooking process.
Blend the blanched spinach into a smooth puree. Set aside.
Heat oil in a pan. Add paneer cubes and fry until light golden. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add cumin seeds and let them splutter. Add onions and sauté until golden brown.
Add garlic, ginger, and green chilies. Cook for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add turmeric, garam masala, coriander powder, and red chili powder. Stir for 30 seconds.
Pour in the spinach puree and cook for 5 minutes. Season with salt.
Add cream and simmer for 5 minutes on low heat. Add fried paneer cubes and cook for another 5 minutes.
Finish with butter and crushed dried fenugreek leaves. Mix well.
Serve hot with naan or rice.

name: Chana Masala
description: Spicy chickpea curry with a tangy tomato sauce, a popular North Indian street food.
ingredients: 2 cans (400g each) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
instructions: Heat oil in a deep pan. Add cumin seeds and bay leaves, let them splutter.
Add onions and sauté until golden brown, about 5-6 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, and green chilies. Sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add tomato puree and cook for 5 minutes until the oil starts to separate.
Add turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, and cumin powder. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add drained chickpeas and salt. Mix well. Add 1 cup of water and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes until the curry thickens and chickpeas are soft.
Add garam masala, dried mango powder, and dried pomegranate powder. Mix well.
Garnish with fresh cilantro leaves and serve hot with rice, naan, or bhatura.
Serve with lemon wedges on the side.

name: Aloo Gobi
description: A dry curry of potatoes and cauliflower cooked with aromatic spices, popular across North India.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add cumin seeds and let them splutter.
Add onions and sauté until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Add ginger-garlic paste and green chilies. Sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
