Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they soften and oil starts to separate, about 5 minutes.
Add turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, and salt. Mix well and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add potato cubes and mix to coat with the spices. Cover and cook for 5 minutes.
Add cauliflower florets and mix gently. Cover and cook for 15 minutes on low heat until vegetables are tender but not mushy, stirring occasionally.
Sprinkle garam masala and dried mango powder. Mix gently.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with roti or rice.

name: Malai Kofta
description: Soft potato and paneer dumplings served in a rich, creamy tomato sauce, a North Indian delicacy.
ingredients: 1/4 cup mixed nuts, finely chopped (cashews, almonds)
instructions: For the kofta: Mix mashed potatoes, crumbled paneer, cornstarch, chopped nuts, raisins, green chili, cilantro, garam masala, and salt.
Shape the mixture into small balls.
Heat oil in a deep pan and fry the koftas until golden brown. Drain on paper towels.
For the gravy: Heat ghee in a pan. Add bay leaf, cinnamon, cardamom, and cloves. Sauté for 30 seconds.
Add onions and sauté until golden brown. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Add tomato puree and cook until oil separates, about 5-7 minutes.
Add turmeric, red chili powder, cumin powder, and coriander powder. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add cashew paste and water. Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add cream, dried fenugreek leaves, and garam masala. Season with salt.
Simmer for 5 minutes, then add koftas just before serving.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with naan or rice.

name: Dal Makhani
description: Creamy black lentils and kidney beans simmered overnight, a rich Punjabi comfort food.
ingredients: 1 cup whole black lentils (urad dal), soaked overnight
instructions: Drain and rinse the soaked lentils and kidney beans.
In a pressure cooker, add lentils, kidney beans, and water. Cook for 20-25 minutes until soft.
In a large pot, heat ghee over medium heat. Add cumin seeds and bay leaf, let them splutter.
Add onions and sauté until golden brown, about 5-6 minutes.
Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add tomato puree, red chili powder, turmeric, and salt. Cook until oil separates, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the cooked lentils and kidney beans. Mash some of them against the side of the pot.
Simmer on low heat for at least 2-3 hours, stirring occasionally. Add water if needed to maintain consistency.
For authentic taste, simmer overnight on low heat (or use a slow cooker).
Before serving, add cream, butter, and garam masala. Mix well.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with naan or rice.

name: Chole Bhature
description: Spicy chickpea curry served with deep-fried bread, a popular North Indian street food.
ingredients: Fresh cilantro, onion rings, and lemon wedges for serving
instructions: For chole: Drain soaked chickpeas. In a pressure cooker, add chickpeas, tea bags, bay leaf, and enough water. Cook for 15-20 minutes until soft.
In a large pot, heat oil. Add cumin seeds and let them splutter.
Add onions and sauté until golden brown. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Add tomato puree and cook until oil separates, about 5-7 minutes.
Add all the spices (coriander, cumin, red chili, turmeric) and salt. Cook for 2 minutes.
Drain the cooked chickpeas (discard tea bags and bay leaf) and add to the pot. Mix well.
Add 1 cup of chickpea cooking water. Simmer for 15-20 minutes until the curry thickens.
Add garam masala, dried mango powder, and dried pomegranate powder. Mix well.
For bhature: In a large bowl, mix flour, semolina, baking powder, and sugar.
Add yogurt and oil. Mix well. Add warm water gradually to form a soft, sticky dough.
Knead for 5 minutes until smooth. Cover and let rest for at least 2 hours.
Divide the dough into 8 equal portions. Roll each into a oval shape about 1/4 inch thick.
Heat oil for deep frying. Fry each bhature until it puffs up and turns golden brown on both sides.
Serve hot chole with bhature, garnished with cilantro, onion rings, and lemon wedges.

name: Paneer Tikka Masala
description: Marinated and grilled paneer chunks in a spicy, creamy tomato-based curry, a restaurant favorite.
instructions: For paneer tikka: In a bowl, mix yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, all the spices, lemon juice, oil, and salt.
Add paneer, bell pepper, and onion chunks. Gently mix to coat. Marinate for at least 2 hours, preferably overnight.
Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Thread marinated paneer and vegetables onto skewers and place on a baking sheet.
Bake for 10-12 minutes until edges start to brown. Alternatively, grill on a stovetop grill pan.
For masala sauce: Heat butter and oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add onions and sauté until golden brown, about 5-6 minutes.
Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add tomato puree and cook until oil separates, about 5-7 minutes.
Add red chili powder, turmeric, coriander powder, cumin powder, and salt. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add 1/2 cup water and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add cream, honey, and garam masala. Mix well.
Add the grilled paneer tikka and vegetables. Stir gently.
Crush dried fenugreek leaves between your palms and add to the curry. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with naan or rice.

name: Vegetable Biryani
description: Fragrant basmati rice cooked with mixed vegetables and aromatic spices in layers, a royal feast.
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, soaked for 30 minutes
4 cups mixed vegetables (carrots, peas, beans, potatoes, cauliflower), cut into chunks
Saffron strands soaked in 2 tbsp warm milk
instructions: Wash and soak rice for 30 minutes. Drain.
In a large pot, bring 4 cups water to a boil. Add salt, bay leaf, 2 cardamom pods, 2 cloves, and half cinnamon stick.
Add the drained rice and cook until 70% done, about 5-7 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Heat 2 tbsp ghee in a large, heavy-bottomed pot. Add remaining whole spices and cumin seeds.
Add sliced onions and sauté until golden brown. Remove half and set aside for garnish.
Add ginger-garlic paste and green chilies. Sauté for 2 minutes.
Add tomatoes and cook until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add all the powdered spices and salt. Mix well.
Add mixed vegetables and cook for 5 minutes.
Add yogurt and mix well. Cook for another 5 minutes.
To layer the biryani: Spread half of the partially cooked rice in a layer over the vegetables.
Sprinkle half of the chopped mint and cilantro, and half of the fried onions.
Spread the remaining rice. Top with remaining herbs and fried onions.
Pour the saffron milk over the top. Cover with a tight-fitting lid.
Cook on low heat for 20-25 minutes. Let it rest for 10 minutes before opening.
Gently mix the layers before serving.

name: Rogan Josh
description: A rich, aromatic lamb curry with a deep red sauce, originating from Kashmir.
ingredients: 2 dried Kashmiri red chilies, soaked and made into paste
instructions: Heat ghee in a large, heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat.
Add bay leaves, cardamom pods, cloves, cinnamon stick, and fennel seeds. Sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add onions and sauté until golden brown, about 8-10 minutes.
Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add lamb pieces and sauté until they change color, about 5-7 minutes.
Add Kashmiri red chili paste, red chili powder, turmeric, coriander powder, and cumin powder. Cook for 2 minutes.
Reduce heat to low. Add yogurt one spoonful at a time, stirring continuously to prevent curdling.
Add tomato puree and salt. Mix well.
Add water, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for about 1 hour or until meat is tender.
Remove lid, add garam masala, and cook for another 10-15 minutes until the sauce thickens and oil rises to the top.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with steamed rice or naan.

name: Pav Bhaji
description: Spicy mashed vegetable curry served with butter-toasted soft bread rolls, a Mumbai street food classic.
ingredients: 1 cup cauliflower, finely chopped and parboiled
1 small onion, finely chopped for garnish
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp butter and oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add 1 chopped onion and sauté until golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste and green chilies. Sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they soften and oil separates, about 5-7 minutes.
Add turmeric, red chili powder, and pav bhaji masala. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add all the boiled and chopped vegetables. Mash them well with a potato masher.
Add 1 cup water and salt. Mix well. Simmer for 15-20 minutes, mashing occasionally.
Add lemon juice and mix well. The bhaji should have a thick, mashed consistency.
For the pav: Slice the bread rolls horizontally, but not all the way through.
Heat a flat pan. Add 1 tbsp butter. Place the pav on the pan, inside facing down. Toast until golden and crisp.
Serve the hot bhaji topped with a dollop of butter, chopped onions, and cilantro.
Serve with toasted pav and lemon wedges on the side.

name: Samosas
description: Crispy pastry triangles filled with spiced potatoes and peas, the quintessential Indian snack.
instructions: For the dough: In a large bowl, mix flour, salt, and carom seeds.
Add ghee and rub into the flour until it resembles breadcrumbs.
Gradually add water and knead to form a firm dough. Cover and let rest for 30 minutes.
For the filling: Heat oil in a pan. Add cumin seeds and let them splutter.
Add onions and sauté until golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste and green chilies. Sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add all the spices (cumin powder, coriander powder, garam masala, red chili powder) and salt. Cook for 1 minute.
Add mashed potatoes and peas. Mix well and cook for 5 minutes.
Add dried mango powder and cilantro. Mix well and let the filling cool completely.
Divide the dough into 12 equal portions. Roll each portion into a circle (about 6 inches in diameter).
Cut each circle in half. Moisten the straight edge with water.
Form a cone by bringing the two ends of the straight edge together, overlapping slightly and pressing to seal.
Fill the cone with about 2 tablespoons of filling. Moisten the top edge of the cone.
Press the edges together to seal completely, forming a triangle. Repeat with remaining dough and filling.
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F (175°C). Fry the samosas in batches until golden brown and crisp, about a5-6 minutes per batch.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with mint chutney and tamarind chutney.

name: Dosa
description: Thin, crispy fermented crepes made from rice and lentil batter, a South Indian breakfast staple.
instructions: Wash and soak rice, urad dal, chana dal, and fenugreek seeds separately for 4-6 hours.
Drain the water. In a blender, grind urad dal and fenugreek seeds to a smooth paste, adding water as needed.
Grind rice and chana dal to a slightly coarse consistency.
Mix both batters together. Add salt and whisk well. The consistency should be like pancake batter.
Cover and let ferment in a warm place for 12-24 hours until the batter rises and becomes slightly sour.
When ready to make dosas, whisk the fermented batter. Add water if needed to get the right consistency.
Heat a flat non-stick or cast iron griddle. Sprinkle a few drops of water to check if it's hot enough.
Pour a ladleful of batter in the center of the griddle. Using the back of the ladle, spread the batter in a circular motion to form a thin crepe.
Drizzle a little oil or ghee around the edges and on top of the dosa.
Cook on medium heat until the bottom turns golden brown and crisp.
For crispy dosas, do not flip. For softer ones, flip and cook briefly on the other side.
Fold the dosa in half or roll it up and serve immediately with coconut chutney and sambar.
For tempering (optional): Heat oil in a small pan. Add mustard seeds and let them splutter.
Add urad dal, chana dal, dried red chilies, asafoetida, and curry leaves. Sauté for 30 seconds.
Pour this tempering over the dosa batter and mix well before making dosas.

name: Tandoori Chicken
description: Chicken marinated in yogurt and spices, traditionally cooked in a clay oven (tandoor).
ingredients: 8 chicken pieces (legs and thighs), skin removed
1 tsp red chili powder (adjust to taste)
Red food coloring (optional, for traditional color)
instructions: Make 2-3 deep cuts in each chicken piece to help the marinade penetrate.
In a large bowl, mix yogurt, lemon juice, ginger-garlic paste, all the spices, salt, and mustard oil (if using).
Add a drop of red food coloring if desired for the traditional tandoori color.
Add the chicken pieces and coat thoroughly with the marinade. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight.
Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) or prepare a grill.
Remove chicken from marinade, shaking off excess. Place on a baking sheet lined with foil.
Bake for 20 minutes. Flip the pieces, baste with butter or oil, and bake for another 10-15 minutes until chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
Alternatively, grill chicken pieces over medium-high heat for 6-8 minutes per side, basting occasionally with butter or oil.
Serve hot, garnished with lemon wedges and onion rings. Pair with mint chutney and naan bread.

name: Idli Sambar
description: Steamed rice cakes (idli) served with a spicy lentil vegetable stew (sambar), a South Indian breakfast classic.
ingredients: 1 small drumstick (moringa pod), cut into pieces (optional)
instructions: For idli: Wash and soak rice and urad dal separately for 4-6 hours. Add fenugreek seeds to urad dal while soaking.
Grind urad dal to a smooth, fluffy batter. Grind rice to a slightly coarse batter.
Mix both batters together. Add salt and mix well. The consistency should be thick but pourable.
Cover and let ferment in a warm place for 8-12 hours until the batter rises and becomes slightly sour.
Grease idli molds. Pour batter into molds, filling each cavity about 3/4 full.
Steam in a pressure cooker or idli steamer for 10-12 minutes until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Let cool slightly before removing idlis from molds.
For sambar: Wash toor dal and cook with turmeric in a pressure cooker until soft, about 4-5 whistles.
In a large pot, add tamarind pulp and all the chopped vegetables. Cook until vegetables are tender.
Add cooked toor dal, sambar powder, and salt. Mix well and simmer for 10 minutes.
For tempering: Heat oil in a small pan. Add mustard seeds and let them splutter.
Add urad dal, dried red chilies, asafoetida, and curry leaves. Sauté for 30 seconds.
Pour the tempering over the sambar. Add chopped cilantro.
Serve hot idlis with sambar and coconut chutney.

name: Kadai Paneer
description: Paneer cheese and bell peppers cooked in a spicy tomato-based gravy with kadai masala, a restaurant favorite.
instructions: For kadai masala: Dry roast all the whole spices (coriander seeds, cumin seeds, dried red chilies, peppercorns, fennel seeds, cinnamon, cardamom) on low heat until fragrant, about 2-3 minutes. Let cool, then grind to a coarse powder.
Heat oil or ghee in a kadai or deep pan over medium heat.
Add cumin seeds and let them splutter. Add ginger-garlic paste and green chilies. Sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add diced onions and sauté until golden brown, about 5-6 minutes.
Add bell peppers and sauté for 3-4 minutes until slightly softened but still crisp.
Add tomato puree and cook until oil separates, about 5-7 minutes.
Add ground kadai masala, red chili powder, turmeric powder, and salt. Cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add 1/2 cup water and simmer for 5 minutes until the gravy thickens.
Add paneer cubes and gently mix. Cook for 3-4 minutes until paneer absorbs the flavors.
Add cream or cashew paste and garam masala. Mix well and simmer for 2-3 minutes.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with naan or rice.

name: Lamb Korma
description: Tender lamb pieces cooked in a rich, mildly spiced yogurt and nut-based sauce, a Mughlai delicacy.
ingredients: Sliced almonds and cilantro for garnish
instructions: Heat ghee or oil in a large, heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat.
Add bay leaves, cardamom pods, cloves, cinnamon stick, and cumin seeds. Sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add onions and sauté until golden brown, about 8-10 minutes.
Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add lamb pieces and sauté until they change color, about 5-7 minutes.
Add turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, and salt. Cook for 2 minutes.
Reduce heat to low. Add yogurt one spoonful at a time, stirring continuously to prevent curdling.
Add cashew paste and poppy seeds paste. Mix well.
Add 1 cup water, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for about 45-50 minutes or until lamb is tender.
Add cream, white pepper powder, and garam masala. Simmer for 10 more minutes.
Stir in fresh mint and cilantro leaves. Adjust seasoning if needed.
Garnish with sliced almonds and cilantro. Serve hot with naan or rice.

name: Masala Dosa
description: Crispy rice and lentil crepe filled with spiced potato filling, a popular South Indian breakfast.
ingredients: Ghee or oil for cooking dosas
instructions: For dosa batter: Follow the same process as regular dosa (see Dosa recipe).
For potato filling: Heat oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds and let them splutter.
Add urad dal and chana dal. Sauté until they turn golden brown.
Add green chilies, ginger, curry leaves, and onions. Sauté until onions are translucent.
Add turmeric powder, red chili powder, coriander powder, and salt. Mix well.
Add mashed potatoes and green peas. Mix well and cook for 5 minutes.
Add chopped cilantro. Mix well and remove from heat.
To make masala dosa: Heat a flat non-stick or cast iron griddle. Sprinkle a few drops of water to check if it's hot enough.
Pour a ladleful of batter in the center of the griddle. Using the back of the ladle, spread the batter in a circular motion to form a thin crepe.
Drizzle a little ghee or oil around the edges and on top of the dosa.
Cook on medium heat until the bottom turns golden brown and crisp.
Place 2-3 tablespoons of potato filling in the center of the dosa.
Fold the dosa in half or roll it up with the filling inside.
Serve immediately with coconut chutney and sambar.

name: Rasmalai
description: Soft paneer dumplings soaked in sweetened, cardamom-flavored milk, a beloved Bengali dessert.
ingredients: A few saffron strands soaked in 2 tbsp warm milk
instructions: To make paneer (cottage cheese): Bring milk to a boil. Add lemon juice to curdle it. Strain the curds in a muslin cloth and rinse under cold water to remove the lemon flavor.
Hang the paneer for 30 minutes to drain excess water.
Knead the paneer with flour and baking powder for 8-10 minutes until smooth and soft.
Divide into small marble-sized balls and flatten slightly.
For sugar syrup: In a wide pan, bring water and sugar to a boil. Stir until sugar dissolves.
Drop the paneer balls into the simmering sugar syrup. Cover and cook for 15 minutes.
The balls will double in size. Remove with a slotted spoon and place in cold water for a few minutes. Gently squeeze out the water.
For milk bath: In a wide pan, bring milk to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer until reduced by half.
Add sugar and cardamom powder. Mix well.
Add saffron milk and nuts. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Add rose water if using.
Add the prepared rasmalai balls to the milk. Let them soak for at least 4-6 hours in the refrigerator.
Serve chilled, garnished with more chopped nuts.

name: Vindaloo
description: A fiery hot curry from Goa with a tangy vinegar-infused marinade, traditionally made with pork.
ingredients: 8-10 dried red chilies, soaked in warm water
instructions: For vindaloo paste: Grind all the paste ingredients together to form a smooth paste.
Marinate the meat with half of the vindaloo paste and refrigerate for at least 3 hours, preferably overnight.
Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onions and sauté until golden brown, about 8 minutes.
Add the remaining vindaloo paste and cook for 3-4 minutes until oil separates.
Add tomatoes and cook until they soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the marinated meat along with the marinade. Cook on high heat for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add 1 cup water, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for 30-40 minutes until meat is tender.
Add jaggery or brown sugar and salt. Mix well.
If needed, cook uncovered for 5-10 more minutes to thicken the gravy.
Garnish with fresh cilantro leaves and serve hot with steamed rice or naan.

name: Gulab Jamun
description: Deep-fried milk solid balls soaked in sugar syrup flavored with cardamom and rose water, a festive Indian sweet.
ingredients: 2-3 tbsp milk, to knead the dough
instructions: For sugar syrup: In a saucepan, combine sugar and water. Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Add cardamom pods, rose water, saffron (if using), and lemon juice. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Keep the syrup warm.
For jamun balls: In a bowl, mix milk powder, flour, and baking soda.
Add melted ghee and mix until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs.
Gradually add milk and knead to form a soft dough. Do not overknead.
Cover and let rest for 10 minutes.
Divide the dough into 15 equal portions and roll into smooth balls. Ensure there are no cracks.
Heat oil in a deep pan over medium-low heat.
Gently slide the balls into the hot oil and fry on low heat, stirring occasionally, until they turn golden brown, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Immediately transfer the hot jamuns to the warm sugar syrup.
Let them soak for at least 2 hours before serving.
Serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Dhokla
description: Steamed savory cake made from fermented rice and chickpea flour, a popular Gujarati snack.
ingredients: 1 tsp fruit salt (eno) or baking soda
instructions: In a large bowl, mix rice flour, chickpea flour, yogurt, water, salt, turmeric powder, ginger-green chili paste, and oil. Mix well to form a smooth batter.
Cover and let ferment for 4-6 hours or overnight in a warm place.
Grease a steaming pan or dhokla plate.
When ready to steam, add fruit salt or baking soda to the batter. Mix gently in one direction until frothy.
Pour the batter into the greased plate.
Steam for 15-20 minutes or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Let cool for 5 minutes, then cut into squares or diamonds.
For tempering: Heat oil in a small pan. Add mustard seeds and let them splutter.
Add cumin seeds, green chilies, and curry leaves. Sauté for 30 seconds.
Add water and lemon juice. Bring to a quick boil.
Pour this tempering over the dhokla pieces. Let it absorb for a few minutes.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and grated coconut.
Serve with green chutney or tamarind chutney.

name: Matar Paneer
description: Paneer cheese and green peas in a tomato-based curry, a popular North Indian dish.
ingredients: 1 cup green peas, fresh or frozen
1/2 tsp dried fenugreek leaves (kasuri methi), crushed
instructions: Heat oil or ghee in a pan over medium heat. Add cumin seeds and let them splutter.
Add onions and sauté until golden brown, about 5-6 minutes.
Add ginger-garlic paste and green chilies. Sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add tomato puree and cook until oil separates, about 5-7 minutes.
Add turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, and salt. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add green peas and 1/2 cup water. Cover and cook for 5-7 minutes until peas are tender.
Add paneer cubes and gently mix. Cook for 3-4 minutes until paneer absorbs the flavors.
Add cream or cashew paste and garam masala. Mix well and simmer for 2-3 minutes.
Crush dried fenugreek leaves between your palms and add to the curry.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with roti or rice.

name: Chicken Tikka
description: Boneless chicken pieces marinated in spiced yogurt and grilled to perfection, a popular appetizer.
ingredients: 500g boneless chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces
Red food coloring (optional, for traditional color)
instructions: In a large bowl, mix yogurt, lemon juice, ginger-garlic paste, all the spices, salt, and mustard oil (if using).
Add a drop of red food coloring if desired for the traditional tandoori color.
Add the chicken pieces and coat thoroughly with the marinade. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight.
Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) or prepare a grill.
Thread marinated chicken onto skewers.
Brush with butter or oil and grill or bake for 12-15 minutes, turning occasionally, until chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
Alternatively, cook in a tandoor if available.
Serve hot, garnished with lemon wedges and onion rings. Serve with mint chutney.

name: Bhindi Masala
description: Okra stir-fried with onions, tomatoes, and spices, a popular vegetarian side dish.
ingredients: 500g okra (bhindi), washed, dried, and cut into 1/2 inch pieces
instructions: Wash okra and pat dry completely. This is crucial to prevent it from becoming slimy.
Cut off the ends and slice into 1/2 inch pieces.
Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add cumin seeds and let them splutter.
Add chopped okra and sauté for 7-8 minutes until it starts to shrink and the sliminess reduces.
Add onions and sauté for 4-5 minutes until they turn translucent.
Add ginger-garlic paste and green chilies. Sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook for 3-4 minutes until they soften.
Add turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, and salt. Mix well.
Cover and cook on low heat for 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until okra is tender but not mushy.
Sprinkle garam masala and amchur. Mix well.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with roti or rice.

name: Baingan Bharta
description: Smoky roasted eggplant mashed and cooked with onions, tomatoes, and spices, a North Indian specialty.
instructions: Wash and pat dry the eggplants. Apply a thin layer of oil over them.
Roast the eggplants directly over a gas flame, turning occasionally, until the skin is charred and the flesh is soft, about 10-15 minutes.
Alternatively, roast in an oven at 425°F (220°C) for 30-35 minutes.
Let the eggplants cool, then peel off the charred skin. Mash the flesh with a fork and set aside.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Add cumin seeds and let them splutter.
Add onions and sauté until golden brown, about 5-6 minutes.
Add green chilies and ginger-garlic paste. Sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they soften and oil separates, about 5-7 minutes.
Add turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, and salt. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add the mashed eggplant and green peas (if using). Mix well.
Cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until flavors blend together and excess moisture evaporates.
Sprinkle garam masala and mix well.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with roti or rice.

name: Gajar Halwa
description: Sweet carrot pudding cooked with milk, ghee, nuts, and cardamom, a traditional winter dessert.
ingredients: 1/4 cup mixed nuts (almonds, cashews, pistachios), chopped
Silver varq (edible silver leaf) for garnish (optional)
instructions: In a large, heavy-bottomed pan, heat ghee over medium heat.
Add grated carrots and sauté for 5-7 minutes until they start to soften.
Add milk and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until the milk reduces completely and the carrots are soft, about 30-35 minutes.
Add sugar and mix well. Cook for another 10 minutes until the mixture thickens.
Add cardamom powder, chopped nuts, and raisins. Mix well.
Add saffron strands if using.
Cook for a few more minutes until the halwa reaches a pudding-like consistency.
Serve warm or cold, garnished with more nuts and silver varq if using.

name: Dum Aloo
description: Baby potatoes cooked in a rich, spicy gravy, a popular North Indian and Kashmiri dish.
instructions: Boil the baby potatoes with skin on until just tender, about 10-15 minutes. Drain and let cool.
Peel the potatoes and prick them all over with a fork.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a deep pan. Fry the potatoes until golden brown, about 5-7 minutes. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add the remaining oil. Add cumin seeds, bay leaf, cardamom pods, and cinnamon stick. Sauté for 30 seconds.
Add onions and sauté until golden brown, about 8 minutes.
Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add tomato puree and cook until oil separates, about 5-7 minutes.
Add asafoetida, turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, and cumin powder. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add yogurt and cashew paste (if using). Mix well and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the fried potatoes and salt. Mix gently to coat the potatoes with the gravy.
Add water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes until the gravy thickens and potatoes absorb the flavors.
Sprinkle garam masala and mix gently.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with naan or rice.

name: Mysore Pak
description: A rich, melt-in-the-mouth sweet made with gram flour, ghee, and sugar, a specialty from South India.
instructions: Sieve the gram flour to remove any lumps.
Grease a plate or tray with ghee and keep it ready.
In a heavy-bottomed pan, add sugar and water. Stir to dissolve the sugar.
Bring to a boil and cook until the syrup reaches one-string consistency (when a drop of syrup forms a single thread between your thumb and index finger).
In another pan, heat 1/4 cup of ghee. Add the gram flour and roast on low heat, stirring continuously, until it becomes aromatic and slightly changes color, about 5-7 minutes.
Slowly pour the sugar syrup into the roasted gram flour, stirring continuously to avoid lumps.
Add cardamom powder if using.
Cook on low heat, stirring continuously, until the mixture starts to thicken and leaves the sides of the pan.
Add the remaining ghee in small batches, stirring after each addition. The mixture will absorb the ghee.
Once all the ghee is incorporated and the mixture looks porous, immediately pour it onto the greased plate.
Level the surface with a spatula. Let it set for 5 minutes.
While still warm, cut into squares or diamonds.
Let it cool completely before removing the pieces from the plate.
Store in an airtight container at room temperature.

name: Rogan Josh
description: A rich, aromatic lamb curry with deep red color and intense flavor, a signature dish from Kashmir.
ingredients: 2 dried Kashmiri red chilies, soaked and ground to paste
instructions: Heat ghee or oil in a heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat.
Add bay leaves, cardamom pods, cloves, cinnamon stick, black cardamom, and fennel seeds. Sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add asafoetida and onions. Sauté until onions are golden brown, about 8-10 minutes.
Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add lamb pieces and sauté until they change color, about 5-7 minutes.
Add Kashmiri red chili paste, red chili powder, turmeric, coriander powder, and cumin powder. Cook for 2 minutes.
Reduce heat to low. Add yogurt one spoonful at a time, stirring continuously to prevent curdling.
Add tomato puree and salt. Mix well.
Add 1 cup water, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Cover and simmer for about 1 hour or until meat is tender and gravy thickens.
Sprinkle garam masala and mix well.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with steamed rice or naan.

name: Buffalo Chicken Wings
description: Classic crispy baked chicken wings tossed in spicy buffalo sauce.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Pat dry the chicken wings and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Bake for 40-45 minutes, flipping halfway.
Mix hot sauce, melted butter, and honey in a bowl.
Toss baked wings in the sauce and serve with ranch dressing.

name: Deviled Eggs
description: Creamy and tangy deviled eggs, a perfect party snack.
instructions: Boil eggs for 10 minutes, then transfer to an ice bath.
Peel, cut in half, and remove yolks.
Mix yolks with mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Pipe or spoon the mixture back into egg whites.
Sprinkle with paprika and serve.

name: Shrimp Cocktail
description: Chilled shrimp served with a tangy cocktail sauce.
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Boil water with salt and lemon slices.
Add shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes, then chill in ice water.
Mix ketchup, horseradish, Worcestershire sauce, lemon juice, and hot sauce.
Serve chilled shrimp with cocktail sauce.

name: Bacon-Wrapped Jalapeño Poppers
description: Spicy jalapeños stuffed with cheese and wrapped in crispy bacon.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Mix cream cheese, cheddar cheese, and garlic powder.
Stuff jalapeño halves with the cheese mixture.
Wrap each with bacon and secure with a toothpick.
Bake for 20 minutes until crispy.

name: Guacamole
description: Fresh homemade guacamole made with ripe avocados and lime.
instructions: Mash avocados in a bowl.
Stir in lime juice, salt, onion, cilantro, tomato, and garlic.
Mix until combined and serve immediately.

name: Stuffed Mushrooms
description: Bite-sized mushrooms filled with a savory cheese and herb mixture.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Remove stems from mushrooms and chop them finely.
Mix chopped stems with cream cheese, Parmesan, parsley, garlic, and pepper.
Stuff mushroom caps with mixture and bake for 20 minutes.

name: Caprese Skewers
description: Mini skewers of cherry tomatoes, mozzarella, and basil drizzled with balsamic glaze.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Thread a cherry tomato, a basil leaf, and a mozzarella ball onto each skewer.
Repeat until all ingredients are used.
Drizzle with balsamic glaze and olive oil.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve immediately.

name: Zucchini Fritters
description: Crispy zucchini fritters made with almond flour and Parmesan cheese.
instructions: Grate zucchini and squeeze out excess water using a clean towel.
In a bowl, mix zucchini, almond flour, Parmesan, egg, garlic powder, and black pepper.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Scoop batter into small patties and cook for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown.
Serve warm with sour cream or yogurt dip.

name: Baked Parmesan Zucchini Fries
description: Crispy zucchini fries coated with Parmesan cheese and baked to perfection.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, mix Parmesan, garlic powder, black pepper, and paprika.
Dip zucchini fries in beaten egg, then coat with Parmesan mixture.
Place on the baking sheet and lightly spray with olive oil.
Bake for 20 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crispy.
Serve with marinara sauce or ranch dressing.

name: Cauliflower Buffalo Bites
description: Spicy and crispy baked cauliflower bites coated in buffalo sauce.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, mix almond flour, garlic powder, paprika, and black pepper.
Coat cauliflower florets in the flour mixture.
Spread on a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes.
Mix hot sauce and melted butter, then toss baked cauliflower in the sauce.
Bake for another 10 minutes and serve with ranch dressing.

name: Gluten-Free Pancakes
description: Fluffy pancakes made with gluten-Free flour, perfect for breakfast.
instructions: In a bowl, mix flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Add milk, egg, melted butter, and vanilla extract. Stir until smooth.
Heat a skillet over medium heat and lightly grease it.
Pour batter to form pancakes and cook until bubbles appear, then flip.
Cook for another 2 minutes until golden brown. Serve with syrup.

name: Avocado Toast with Eggs
description: A delicious and healthy avocado toast on gluten-Free bread topped with eggs.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Toast the gluten-Free bread until golden brown.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Spread mashed avocado on toast.
Heat oil in a pan and fry eggs to your preference.
Place eggs on top of the toast and serve.

name: Gluten-Free Oatmeal
description: Warm and comforting oatmeal made with certified gluten-Free oats.
instructions: In a saucepan, bring milk or water to a boil.
Stir in oats, cinnamon, and salt. Reduce heat to low and cook for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla and honey.
Top with nuts or fruit and serve warm.

name: Smoothie Bowl
description: A thick and nutritious smoothie bowl topped with fresh fruits and seeds.
ingredients: 1/2 cup Greek yogurt or dairy-Free alternative
instructions: Blend banana, berries, yogurt, and milk until smooth.
Pour into a bowl and top with chia seeds, granola, and fresh fruit.
Drizzle with honey if desired and serve immediately.

name: Egg Muffins
description: Easy-to-make baked egg muffins loaded with veggies and cheese.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) and grease a muffin tin.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper.
Stir in bell peppers, spinach, and cheese.
Pour mixture into muffin tin and bake for 20 minutes.
Let cool slightly before serving.

name: Chia Pudding
description: A creamy and nutritious chia seed pudding perfect for breakfast.
instructions: In a bowl, mix chia seeds, almond milk, honey, and vanilla.
Stir well and refrigerate overnight.
Stir again before serving and top with fresh berries.

name: Sweet Potato Hash
description: A hearty and nutritious sweet potato hash with eggs and veggies.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add diced sweet potatoes and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add onion, bell peppers, salt, pepper, and paprika. Cook for another 5 minutes.
Make small wells in the mixture and crack eggs into them.
Cover and cook until eggs reach desired doneness. Serve warm.

name: Coconut Flour Waffles
description: Light and fluffy gluten-Free waffles made with coconut flour.
ingredients: 1 tbsp melted butter or coconut oil
instructions: Preheat waffle iron and grease with oil.
In a bowl, whisk coconut flour, baking powder, and salt.
In another bowl, whisk eggs, milk, butter, vanilla, and maple syrup.
Combine wet and dry ingredients, stirring until smooth.
Cook in waffle iron for 3-5 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie
description: A protein-packed smoothie with peanut butter, banana, and milk.
instructions: Blend banana, peanut butter, milk, and ice until smooth.
Pour into a glass and sprinkle with cinnamon if desired.
Serve immediately.

name: Bacon and Cheese Omelette
description: A delicious and cheesy omelette loaded with crispy bacon.
instructions: Whisk eggs, milk, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Heat butter in a pan over medium heat.
Pour egg mixture and cook until edges set.
Sprinkle cheese and bacon on one side, then fold the omelette.
Cook for another minute and serve warm.

name: Flourless Chocolate Cake
description: A rich and fudgy chocolate cake made without flour, perfect for chocolate lovers.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a cake pan.
Melt chocolate and butter together in a double boiler.
Whisk in sugar, eggs, cocoa powder, vanilla, and salt until smooth.
Pour into the pan and bake for 25-30 minutes.
Let cool before serving. Optionally, dust with powdered sugar.

name: Gluten-Free Brownies
description: Chewy and fudgy brownies made with gluten-Free flour.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a baking pan.
Whisk melted butter and sugar together, then add eggs and vanilla.
Mix in cocoa powder, gluten-Free flour, and salt until combined.
Fold in chocolate chips and pour into the pan.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, then let cool before slicing.

name: Peanut Butter Cookies
description: Soft and chewy peanut butter cookies made with simple ingredients.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix peanut butter, sugar, egg, baking soda, salt, and vanilla in a bowl.
Roll dough into small balls and place on the baking sheet.
Press each cookie with a fork to create a crisscross pattern.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, then let cool before serving.

name: Coconut Macaroons
description: Chewy coconut macaroons with a crisp golden exterior.
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F (160°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix shredded coconut, condensed milk, and vanilla in a bowl.
In another bowl, beat egg whites with salt until stiff peaks form.
Fold egg whites into the coconut mixture.
Scoop small mounds onto the baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes.
Let cool before serving.

name: Gluten-Free Cheesecake
description: A creamy and rich cheesecake with a gluten-Free almond crust.
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F (160°C) and grease a springform pan.
Mix almond flour, melted butter, and sugar, then press into the pan.
Bake crust for 10 minutes, then let cool.
Beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth, then add eggs and vanilla.
Mix in sour cream and pour over the crust.
Bake for 50-60 minutes, then chill before serving.

name: Gluten-Free Apple Crisp
description: A warm and comforting apple crisp with a crunchy oat topping.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Toss apples with sugar and cinnamon, then place in a baking dish.
Mix oats, almond flour, brown sugar, and melted butter until crumbly.
Spread topping over apples and bake for 35-40 minutes.
Serve warm, optionally with vanilla ice cream.

name: Almond Butter Blondies
description: Chewy and nutty blondies made with almond butter.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a baking pan.
Mix almond butter, honey, egg, vanilla, salt, and baking soda.
Fold in chocolate chips and pour batter into the pan.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, then let cool before slicing.

name: Chocolate Avocado Mousse
description: A creamy and rich chocolate mousse made with avocado.
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a food processor until smooth.
Spoon into serving dishes and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Serve chilled, optionally topped with berries or whipped cream.

name: Rice Pudding
description: A creamy and comforting rice pudding with cinnamon and vanilla.
instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions.
In a saucepan, heat milk, sugar, vanilla, cinnamon, and salt.
Add cooked rice and simmer for 10-15 minutes until thick.
Serve warm or chilled, optionally topped with raisins or nuts.

name: Gluten-Free Pumpkin Pie
description: A delicious pumpkin pie with a gluten-Free crust.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Whisk pumpkin puree, brown sugar, spices, eggs, and milk.
Pour into the gluten-Free pie crust and bake for 50 minutes.
Let cool before serving, optionally with whipped cream.

name: Grilled Lemon Garlic Chicken
description: Juicy grilled chicken marinated in lemon, garlic, and herbs.
instructions: In a bowl, mix olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Marinate chicken for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat grill to medium heat and cook chicken for 6-7 minutes per side.
Let rest for a few minutes before serving.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Bell peppers filled with a savory mix of ground beef, rice, and tomatoes.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Cut tops off bell peppers and remove seeds.
In a skillet, cook ground beef and onion until browned.
Add rice, diced tomatoes, and seasonings; mix well.
Stuff each bell pepper with the beef mixture and place in a baking dish.
Top with cheese and bake for 25-30 minutes.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
description: Pan-seared shrimp tossed in garlic butter sauce.
instructions: Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add shrimp, paprika, salt, and pepper, and cook for 2-3 minutes per side.
Stir in lemon juice and parsley before serving.

name: BBQ Baked Salmon
description: Oven-baked salmon coated in a smoky BBQ glaze.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Place salmon fillets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush salmon with olive oil, then season with garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Coat with BBQ sauce and bake for 15-20 minutes until flaky.

name: Zucchini Noodles with Pesto
description: A light and healthy gluten-Free pasta alternative with fresh pesto.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add zucchini noodles and cook for 2-3 minutes until tender.
Remove from heat and toss with pesto, salt, and pepper.
Serve warm with grated Parmesan if desired.

name: Cajun Grilled Pork Chops
description: Juicy pork chops with a smoky Cajun spice rub.
instructions: Rub pork chops with olive oil and season with Cajun seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Preheat grill to medium heat and cook pork chops for 6-7 minutes per side.
Let rest for a few minutes before serving.

name: Gluten-Free Meatloaf
description: A hearty and flavorful meatloaf made without breadcrumbs.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Mix all ingredients in a bowl until well combined.
Shape into a loaf and place in a baking dish.
Bake for 45-50 minutes until cooked through.
Let rest before slicing and serving.

name: Creamy Garlic Mashed Cauliflower
description: A light and creamy alternative to mashed potatoes.
instructions: Steam cauliflower until tender, about 10 minutes.
In a pan, sauté garlic in butter until fragrant.
Blend cauliflower, garlic butter, milk, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Serve warm as a side dish.

name: Balsamic Glazed Chicken
description: Tender chicken breasts coated in a sweet and tangy balsamic glaze.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Season chicken with garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Cook chicken for 6-7 minutes per side until golden brown.
Add balsamic vinegar and honey, simmering until thickened.
Coat chicken with glaze and serve.

name: Shepherd's Pie
description: A comforting casserole with a savory meat and veggie filling topped with mashed potatoes.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a skillet, cook beef and onion until browned.
Add vegetables, broth, tomato paste, salt, and pepper. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Transfer mixture to a baking dish and spread mashed potatoes on top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until golden brown.

name: Grilled Chicken Salad
description: A fresh and healthy salad with grilled chicken and homemade dressing.
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper.
Grill over medium heat for 6-7 minutes per side until fully cooked.
Let rest, then slice into strips.
In a large bowl, toss greens, tomatoes, onion, and feta.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
Top with grilled chicken and serve.

name: Lettuce Wrap Turkey Burgers
description: Juicy turkey burgers wrapped in crisp lettuce instead of buns.
instructions: Preheat grill or skillet over medium heat.
Mix turkey, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Form into patties and cook for 5-6 minutes per side until fully cooked.
Wrap each patty in a lettuce leaf with avocado, tomatoes, and onion.
Serve immediately.

name: Quinoa Avocado Bowl
description: A nutritious bowl with quinoa, avocado, and fresh veggies.
instructions: In a bowl, mix quinoa, tomatoes, and cucumbers.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.
Season with salt and pepper.
Top with sliced avocado and serve.

name: Gluten-Free BLT Wrap
description: A delicious gluten-Free wrap with crispy bacon, lettuce, and tomato.
instructions: Lay tortillas flat and spread mayonnaise on each.
Add lettuce, tomatoes, and bacon slices.
Roll tightly and slice in half before serving.

name: Tuna Salad Stuffed Avocados
description: A fresh and creamy tuna salad served inside an avocado.
instructions: In a bowl, mix tuna, mayonnaise, salt, pepper, and lemon juice.
Scoop out a little avocado flesh to create more space.
Fill each avocado half with tuna salad and serve.

name: BBQ Chicken Lettuce Wraps
description: Tender shredded BBQ chicken wrapped in crisp lettuce.
instructions: Cook chicken in a skillet over medium heat for 6-7 minutes per side until fully cooked.
Shred chicken and mix with BBQ sauce.
Spoon chicken into lettuce leaves and top with carrots and red onion.
Serve immediately.

name: Cauliflower Fried Rice
description: A low-carb, gluten-Free version of classic fried rice.
ingredients: 2 tbsp coconut aminos or gluten-Free soy sauce
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add cauliflower rice, carrots, and peas, stirring for 5 minutes.
Push veggies to the side, pour in eggs, and scramble.
Mix everything together and add coconut aminos.
Cook for another 2 minutes and serve.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Bell peppers stuffed with a savory mix of ground turkey and vegetables.
ingredients: 4 bell peppers, halved and seeds removed
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Cook ground turkey in a skillet over medium heat until browned.
Mix with quinoa, tomatoes, salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Stuff bell pepper halves with the mixture and place in a baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes and serve.

name: Avocado Chicken Salad
description: A creamy and refreshing chicken salad made with avocado.
instructions: Mash avocado in a bowl and mix with lime juice, salt, and pepper.
Stir in shredded chicken and cilantro.
Serve as a salad or inside lettuce wraps.

name: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Bowl
description: A nutritious bowl with roasted sweet potatoes and black beans.
ingredients: 1/2 cup black beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Toss sweet potato cubes with olive oil, chili powder, salt, and pepper.
Spread on a baking sheet and roast for 25 minutes.
Serve with black beans in a bowl.

name: Garlic Roasted Brussels Sprouts
description: Crispy roasted Brussels sprouts with garlic and olive oil.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Toss Brussels sprouts with olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Spread on a baking sheet and roast for 25 minutes, stirring halfway.
Serve hot.

name: Baked Sweet Potato Fries
description: Crispy oven-baked sweet potato fries with a touch of seasoning.
ingredients: 2 large sweet potatoes, cut into fries
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss sweet potato fries with olive oil, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Spread on a baking sheet in a single layer.
Bake for 30 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Serve warm.

name: Grilled Asparagus with Lemon
description: Tender grilled asparagus with a zesty lemon touch.
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat.
Toss asparagus with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Grill for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Drizzle with lemon juice before serving.

name: Mashed Cauliflower
description: A creamy and low-carb alternative to mashed potatoes.
instructions: Boil cauliflower in salted water for 10-12 minutes until tender.
Drain and mash with butter and milk.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve warm.

name: Roasted Garlic Mushrooms
description: Savory roasted mushrooms with garlic and herbs.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Toss mushrooms with olive oil, garlic, salt, pepper, and thyme.
Spread on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes.
Serve warm.

name: Cheesy Broccoli Bake
description: A creamy, cheesy baked broccoli side dish.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Steam broccoli until tender, about 5 minutes.
Mix with cheddar cheese, heavy cream, butter, salt, and pepper.
Transfer to a baking dish and bake for 20 minutes.
Serve warm.

name: Honey Glazed Carrots
description: Tender carrots coated in a delicious honey glaze.
instructions: Boil carrots for 10 minutes until tender, then drain.
Melt butter in a pan over medium heat.
Add honey, salt, and pepper, then toss in carrots.
Cook for 5 minutes until glazed and serve warm.

name: Parmesan Zucchini Chips
description: Crispy baked zucchini chips with Parmesan cheese.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Toss zucchini slices with olive oil, Parmesan, salt, and pepper.
Arrange on a baking sheet in a single layer.
Bake for 20-25 minutes until crispy.
Serve immediately.

name: Garlic Butter Green Beans
description: Crisp green beans sautéed with garlic butter.
instructions: Boil green beans for 5 minutes until tender-crisp, then drain.
Melt butter in a pan over medium heat.
Sauté garlic for 1 minute, then add green beans.
Season with salt and pepper and cook for another 3 minutes.
Serve warm.

name: Crispy Roasted Chickpeas
description: Crunchy roasted chickpeas seasoned to perfection.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Pat chickpeas dry and toss with olive oil and seasonings.
Spread on a baking sheet in a single layer.
Bake for 30 minutes, shaking halfway through.
Cool slightly before serving.

name: Peanut Butter Energy Bites
description: No-bake energy bites made with peanut butter, honey, and oats.
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl until well combined.
Roll into small balls and refrigerate for 30 minutes before serving.

name: Apple Chips
description: Crispy baked apple chips with a touch of cinnamon.
instructions: Preheat oven to 225°F (110°C).
Arrange apple slices on a baking sheet and sprinkle with cinnamon.
Bake for 2 hours, flipping halfway through, until crispy.
Let cool before serving.

name: Banana Oat Muffins
description: Gluten-Free banana muffins made with oats and honey.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Mix all ingredients in a bowl until combined.
Spoon batter into muffin cups and bake for 20 minutes.
Let cool before serving.

name: Trail Mix
description: A simple and healthy gluten-Free snack mix.
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl.
Store in an airtight container for snacking.

name: Coconut Yogurt Parfait
description: A creamy yogurt parfait with fresh berries and granola.
instructions: Layer yogurt, berries, and granola in a glass.
Drizzle with honey and serve.

name: Roasted Pumpkin Seeds
description: Crunchy and salty roasted pumpkin seeds.
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F (165°C).
Toss pumpkin seeds with olive oil and salt.
Spread on a baking sheet and roast for 25 minutes, stirring halfway.
Let cool before serving.

name: Cheese and Almond Crackers
description: Gluten-Free almond crackers with cheese.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Mix all ingredients into a dough and roll out thin.
Cut into small squares and bake for 15 minutes.
Cool before serving.

name: Baked Kale Chips
description: Crispy, healthy baked kale chips.
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°F (150°C).
Toss kale leaves with olive oil and salt.
Spread on a baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes.
Cool before serving.

name: Stuffed Avocado with Tuna
description: Creamy avocado halves filled with a delicious tuna salad.
instructions: In a bowl, mix tuna, mayonnaise, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Scoop tuna mixture into avocado halves and serve.

name: Frozen Yogurt Bark
description: A refreshing frozen yogurt snack with fruit and nuts.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix yogurt and honey, then spread in a thin layer on the sheet.
Sprinkle with berries and almonds.
Freeze for 3 hours until firm, then break into pieces.

name: Classic Deviled Eggs
description: Creamy and tangy deviled eggs with mustard and paprika.
instructions: Boil eggs for 10 minutes, then cool and peel.
Cut eggs in half and remove yolks.
Mix yolks with mayonnaise, mustard, salt, and pepper.
Spoon mixture back into egg whites and sprinkle with paprika.

name: Buffalo Chicken Dip
description: Spicy and creamy buffalo chicken dip with cheese.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Mix all ingredients in a bowl.
Transfer to a baking dish and bake for 20 minutes until bubbly.
Serve with celery sticks or crackers.

name: Garlic Parmesan Wings
description: Crispy baked chicken wings with garlic and Parmesan.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Bake wings for 40 minutes, flipping halfway.
Melt butter and mix with garlic, Parmesan, salt, and pepper.
Toss baked wings in the garlic Parmesan mixture and serve.

name: Spinach Artichoke Dip
description: Creamy spinach and artichoke dip baked until bubbly.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Mix all ingredients in a bowl.
Transfer to a baking dish and bake for 25 minutes until bubbly.
Serve with tortilla chips or crackers.

name: Shrimp Cocktail
description: Chilled shrimp served with tangy cocktail sauce.
instructions: Boil shrimp for 5 minutes until pink, then chill.
Serve with cocktail sauce and lemon juice.

name: Crispy Baked Tofu Bites
description: Crispy, golden tofu bites with a savory seasoning.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Toss tofu cubes with olive oil and seasonings.
Spread on a baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes, flipping halfway.
Serve with dipping sauce.

name: Stuffed Mini Peppers
description: Sweet mini peppers filled with creamy avocado and lime.
ingredients: 8 mini bell peppers, halved and deseeded
instructions: Mash avocado with lime juice and salt.
Fill mini peppers with the mixture.
Garnish with cilantro and serve.

name: Cheesy Spinach Stuffed Mushrooms
description: Mushroom caps filled with a cheesy spinach mixture.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Mix spinach, cream cheese, mozzarella, and garlic powder.
Stuff mushrooms with the mixture.
Bake for 20 minutes and serve.

name: Caprese Skewers
description: Mini Caprese salad on skewers with balsamic glaze.
instructions: Skewer a tomato, mozzarella, and basil leaf onto each toothpick.
Drizzle with balsamic glaze and serve.

name: Crispy Cauliflower Buffalo Bites
description: Spicy and crispy baked cauliflower bites with buffalo sauce.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Whisk flour, water, garlic powder, and salt to make a batter.
Dip cauliflower in the batter and place on a baking sheet.
Bake for 20 minutes, toss with buffalo sauce, and bake for 10 more minutes.
Serve with vegan ranch dip.

name: Zucchini Fritters
description: Crispy and golden zucchini fritters with herbs and spices.
instructions: Squeeze excess water from grated zucchini.
Mix with chickpea flour, green onions, salt, and garlic powder.
Form small patties and cook in a pan with olive oil until golden brown.
Serve with vegan sour cream or salsa.

name: Cheesy Jalapeño Poppers
description: Spicy jalapeño poppers stuffed with creamy cheese and baked.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Mix cream cheese, cheddar cheese, and garlic powder.
Stuff jalapeño halves with the cheese mixture.
Sprinkle with breadcrumbs and bake for 15 minutes.
Serve hot.

name: Mozzarella Sticks
description: Crispy breaded mozzarella sticks with marinara sauce.
instructions: Dip each mozzarella stick in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs.
Freeze for 30 minutes to prevent melting.
Fry in hot oil until golden brown.
Serve with marinara sauce.

name: Avocado Cucumber Sushi Rolls
description: Light and refreshing vegan sushi rolls with creamy avocado and crisp cucumber.
instructions: Cook sushi rice according to package instructions.
Mix rice vinegar, sugar, and salt in a small bowl until dissolved.
When rice is done, transfer to a large bowl and gently fold in the vinegar mixture.
Let rice cool to room temperature.
Place a nori sheet on a bamboo sushi mat, shiny side down.
With wet hands, spread about 1/2 cup of rice evenly over the nori, leaving a 1-inch border at the top.
Arrange avocado and cucumber slices in a line across the center of the rice.
Roll the sushi tightly from the bottom, using the mat as a guide.
Seal the edge with a little water.
Cut each roll into 8 pieces with a wet, sharp knife.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger.

name: Quinoa Breakfast Bowl with Berries
description: A nutritious breakfast bowl with protein-rich quinoa, fresh berries, and nuts.
ingredients: 2 cups almond milk, plus more for serving
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine quinoa, almond milk, honey or maple syrup, vanilla, cinnamon, and salt.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until quinoa is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Fluff with a fork and let cool slightly.
Divide the quinoa between two bowls.
Top with mixed berries, sliced almonds, and chia seeds.
Pour a little additional almond milk over the top if desired.
Serve warm.

name: Mango Coconut Chia Pudding
description: A tropical dessert made with chia seeds, coconut milk, and fresh mango.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together chia seeds, coconut milk, maple syrup, and vanilla extract.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight, stirring occasionally to prevent clumping.
Once the pudding has thickened, divide half of it among four serving glasses or bowls.
Add a layer of diced mango.
Top with the remaining chia pudding.
Garnish with more diced mango, toasted coconut flakes, and mint leaves.
Serve chilled.

name: Mediterranean Baked Cod
description: Flaky cod fillets baked with tomatoes, olives, and herbs in Mediterranean style.
ingredients: 1/2 cup Kalamata olives, pitted and halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large ovenproof skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat.
Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add cherry tomatoes, olives, half of the parsley, lemon juice, oregano, and red pepper flakes. Cook for 5 minutes until tomatoes begin to soften.
Season cod fillets with salt and pepper on both sides.
Nestle the cod fillets into the tomato mixture.
Top with lemon slices.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 12-15 minutes, until fish flakes easily with a fork.
Sprinkle with remaining fresh parsley before serving.

name: Vietnamese Rice Paper Rolls
description: Fresh and vibrant rice paper rolls filled with vegetables, herbs and your choice of protein.
instructions: Cook rice vermicelli according to package instructions. Drain and rinse under cold water.
Prepare all vegetables and herbs and arrange on a plate for easy assembly.
Fill a large, shallow dish with warm water.
Dip one rice paper wrapper in the warm water for about 10-15 seconds until it starts to soften.
Lay the softened wrapper on a clean, damp kitchen towel.
Place a small handful of vermicelli noodles, some cucumber, carrot, bell pepper, avocado, bean sprouts, and herbs in the center of the wrapper.
Fold the bottom of the wrapper over the filling, then fold in the sides, and roll tightly to close.
Repeat with remaining wrappers and filling ingredients.
For the dipping sauce, whisk together hoisin sauce, peanut butter (if using), rice vinegar, water, and sriracha in a small bowl.
Serve the rolls with the dipping sauce.

name: Rosemary Roasted Sweet Potatoes
description: Crispy on the outside, tender on the inside sweet potatoes with aromatic rosemary.
ingredients: 2 lbs sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
In a large bowl, toss sweet potatoes with olive oil, rosemary, garlic, salt, pepper, and paprika until evenly coated.
Spread sweet potatoes in a single layer on a large baking sheet.
Roast for 25-30 minutes, turning once halfway through, until potatoes are golden and crispy on the outside and tender inside.
Serve hot as a side dish.

name: Spiced Chickpea Snack Mix
description: Crunchy roasted chickpeas with warm spices make for a protein-rich snack.
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz each) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Thoroughly dry chickpeas with paper towels, removing any loose skins.
In a bowl, toss chickpeas with olive oil and all spices until evenly coated.
Spread chickpeas in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Roast for 25-30 minutes, shaking the pan halfway through, until chickpeas are crispy.
Let cool completely before storing in an airtight container.
Enjoy as a snack or salad topper.

name: Classic Gazpacho
description: A refreshing cold soup from Spain made with ripe tomatoes and fresh vegetables.
ingredients: 2 tbsp sherry vinegar or red wine vinegar
For garnish: diced cucumber, bell pepper, red onion, and a drizzle of olive oil
instructions: Combine tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper, red onion, and garlic in a blender.
Blend until smooth.
With the blender running, slowly add olive oil and vinegar.
Season with salt and pepper.
Strain the soup through a fine-mesh sieve to remove any solids (optional for a smoother texture).
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours to chill completely and allow flavors to develop.
Serve cold, garnished with diced vegetables and a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Gluten-Free Banana Pancakes
description: Fluffy gluten-Free pancakes with sweet banana flavor, perfect for a weekend breakfast.
ingredients: 1/2 cup almond milk (or any milk of choice)
2 tbsp maple syrup, plus more for serving
2 tbsp melted coconut oil or butter, plus more for cooking
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together gluten-Free flour, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon.
In another bowl, mash the bananas. Add eggs, milk, maple syrup, vanilla, and melted coconut oil. Mix well.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir just until combined. Do not overmix.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat. Add a little coconut oil or butter.
Pour 1/4 cup of batter for each pancake onto the hot skillet.
Cook until bubbles form on the surface, about 2-3 minutes, then flip and cook for another 1-2 minutes.
Serve warm with additional maple syrup and fresh banana slices.

name: Dark Chocolate Avocado Mousse
description: A rich and creamy chocolate dessert made with ripe avocados instead of dairy.
ingredients: 1/2 cup maple syrup or agave nectar
instructions: In a food processor or blender, combine avocados, cocoa powder, maple syrup, almond milk, vanilla extract, and salt.
Process until smooth and creamy, stopping to scrape down the sides as needed.
Add the melted chocolate and blend again until well incorporated.
Divide the mousse into individual serving dishes.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours to set and chill.
Garnish with fresh berries before serving.

name: Vegan Pad Thai
description: A plant-based version of the classic Thai noodle dish with tofu and peanut sauce.
instructions: Cook rice noodles according to package instructions.
Sauté tofu in a pan until golden brown.
Add garlic, soy sauce, lime juice, and chili flakes.
Toss in cooked noodles and bean sprouts.
Garnish with peanuts and serve.

name: Gluten-Free Blueberry Pancakes
description: Fluffy pancakes made with gluten-Free flour and fresh blueberries.
instructions: Mix flour, baking powder, and almond milk.
Whisk in egg and honey.
Fold in blueberries.
Cook pancakes on a greased pan until golden brown.
Serve with maple syrup.

name: Nut-Free Chicken Tikka
description: Indian-style grilled chicken with a blend of aromatic spices.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, spices, and lemon juice for at least 1 hour.
Preheat grill or oven to 400°F (200°C).
Grill chicken until fully cooked and slightly charred.
Serve with mint chutney.

name: Vegan Avocado Toast
description: Classic avocado toast with a sprinkle of red pepper flakes and lemon juice.
instructions: Toast the gluten-Free bread.
Mash avocado with lemon juice and salt.
Spread avocado mixture over the toast and sprinkle with red pepper flakes.
Serve immediately.

name: French Onion Soup
description: A rich and savory French soup made with caramelized onions and melted cheese.
instructions: Melt butter in a large pot and caramelize onions over low heat.
Add thyme and vegetable broth, then simmer for 20 minutes.
Ladle soup into bowls, top with toasted baguette and grated Gruyere cheese.
Broil until cheese melts and serve hot.

name: Gluten-Free Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Delicious, chewy cookies made with gluten-Free flour and chocolate chips.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Mix all ingredients together until combined.
Scoop dough onto a baking sheet and bake for 12 minutes.
Cool on a rack before serving.

name: Japanese Miso Soup
description: A traditional Japanese soup with miso, tofu, and seaweed.
instructions: Heat water in a pot, then dissolve miso paste.
Add tofu and seaweed, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Garnish with green onions and serve hot.

name: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
description: A fresh and healthy salad with chickpeas, cucumbers, tomatoes, and olives.
instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl.
Toss with olive oil, lemon juice, and oregano.
Serve chilled.

name: Nut-Free Grilled Salmon
description: A simple and flavorful grilled salmon with lemon and herbs.
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat.
Rub salmon with olive oil, salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Grill for 4-5 minutes per side until fully cooked.
Drizzle with lemon juice before serving.

name: Vegan Lentil Soup
description: A hearty and nutritious soup made with lentils and vegetables.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pot and sauté onions, carrots, and celery.
Add lentils, vegetable broth, cumin, and salt.
Simmer for 30 minutes until lentils are tender.
Blend slightly for a creamy texture, if desired.

name: Vegetarian Stuffed Peppers
description: Bell peppers stuffed with a flavorful mix of rice, beans, and spices.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Cut tops off bell peppers and remove seeds.
Mix rice, beans, tomatoes, cumin, and salt.
Stuff the peppers with the mixture and top with cheese.
Bake for 30-35 minutes and serve.

name: Gluten-Free Banana Muffins
description: Soft and moist banana muffins made with gluten-Free flour.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Mix all ingredients until combined.
Scoop batter into muffin tins.
Bake for 20 minutes until golden brown.

name: Vegan Jackfruit Tacos
description: Tacos filled with shredded jackfruit and a smoky spice blend.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté jackfruit.
Add spices and cook for 10 minutes until tender.
Shred jackfruit with a fork and serve in tortillas.

name: Nut-Free Pesto Pasta
description: A creamy pesto pasta made with sunflower seeds instead of nuts.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions.
Blend basil, sunflower seeds, Parmesan, garlic, olive oil, and salt to make pesto.
Toss cooked pasta with pesto and serve.

name: Vegan Sweet Potato Fries
description: Crispy and seasoned baked sweet potato fries.
ingredients: 2 large sweet potatoes, sliced into fries
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Toss sweet potato fries with olive oil and spices.
Bake for 25 minutes until crispy.
Serve with dipping sauce of choice.

name: Vegetarian Spinach and Cheese Quesadilla
description: A crispy quesadilla filled with spinach and melted cheese.
instructions: Heat a pan over medium heat.
Place one tortilla in the pan and sprinkle cheese and spinach on top.
Place the second tortilla on top and cook for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown.
Slice and serve warm.

name: Gluten-Free Pancakes
description: Fluffy pancakes made with gluten-Free flour and a touch of vanilla.
instructions: In a bowl, mix all dry ingredients.
Whisk in the egg, milk, vanilla, and melted butter.
Heat a pan over medium heat and pour small amounts of batter to form pancakes.
Cook for 2-3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Serve with maple syrup.

name: Vegan Avocado Toast
description: Creamy mashed avocado on toasted whole grain bread.
instructions: Toast the bread slices.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Spread mashed avocado on toasted bread and sprinkle with red pepper flakes.
Serve immediately.

name: Nut-Free Chicken Stir-Fry
description: A flavorful stir-fry made with chicken and fresh vegetables.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan and cook chicken until browned.
Add vegetables and stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Pour in soy sauce and garlic powder, stir well.
Serve hot with rice or noodles.

name: Vegetarian Tomato Basil Soup
description: A creamy and flavorful tomato soup with fresh basil.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pot and sauté onions and garlic.
Add chopped tomatoes and vegetable broth, simmer for 20 minutes.
Blend the mixture until smooth.
Stir in heavy cream, basil, and salt, then simmer for another 5 minutes.
Serve hot.

name: Gluten-Free Blueberry Muffins
description: Soft and delicious blueberry muffins made with gluten-Free flour.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Mix dry ingredients together in a bowl.
Add wet ingredients and stir until combined.
Fold in blueberries gently.
Pour batter into muffin cups and bake for 20 minutes.
Let cool and serve.

name: Vegan Chickpea Salad
description: A protein-rich, refreshing salad made with chickpeas and fresh vegetables.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix all ingredients together.
Toss well to combine flavors.
Chill for 10 minutes before serving.

name: Nut-Free Honey Garlic Chicken
description: A sweet and savory honey garlic chicken dish perfect for dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan and cook chicken until golden brown.
Add garlic and sauté for a minute.
Pour in honey and soy sauce, stir well.
Simmer for 5 minutes and serve hot.

name: Vegetarian Mushroom Risotto
description: A creamy and flavorful risotto with mushrooms and Parmesan cheese.
instructions: Heat butter in a pan and sauté onions and mushrooms.
Add rice and cook for a minute.
Gradually add broth while stirring.
Cook until rice is tender and creamy.
Stir in Parmesan cheese and serve.

name: Gluten-Free Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Chewy and delicious gluten-Free chocolate chip cookies.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Cream butter, sugar, and vanilla.
Mix in egg, then add dry ingredients.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Scoop dough onto baking sheet and bake for 12 minutes.
Let cool and enjoy.

name: Vegan Lentil Soup
description: A hearty and protein-packed soup made with lentils and vegetables.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pot and sauté onions, garlic, and carrots.
Add lentils and vegetable broth, bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes until lentils are soft.
Season with cumin and salt, then serve warm.

name: Nut-Free Teriyaki Chicken
description: A flavorful and juicy teriyaki chicken dish with a homemade sauce.
instructions: Mix soy sauce, honey, ginger, and garlic in a bowl.
Heat oil in a pan and cook chicken until browned.
Add the sauce and cook for 5 minutes.
Dissolve cornstarch in water and stir into sauce to thicken.
Serve with rice.

name: Vegetarian Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Colorful bell peppers stuffed with rice, beans, and spices.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Cut off tops of bell peppers and remove seeds.
Mix rice, beans, corn, tomatoes, cumin, and salt.
Stuff mixture into peppers and top with cheese.
Bake for 30 minutes until peppers are tender.

name: Gluten-Free Banana Bread
description: A moist and delicious banana bread made without gluten.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Mix mashed bananas, sugar, melted butter, and eggs.
Stir in flour, baking powder, and cinnamon.
Pour batter into a greased loaf pan.
Bake for 50 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool before slicing.

name: Vegan Sweet Potato Fries
description: Crispy and seasoned sweet potato fries, baked to perfection.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Cut sweet potatoes into fries and toss with oil and seasonings.
Spread evenly on a baking sheet.
Bake for 30 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Serve hot with dipping sauce.

name: Vegan Avocado Toast
description: A simple yet delicious avocado toast with a sprinkle of chili flakes and lemon.
instructions: Toast the bread slices until crispy.
Mash the avocado and mix with lemon juice and salt.
Spread mashed avocado over toast.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle chili flakes on top.
Serve immediately.

name: Nut-Free Grilled Chicken Salad
description: A fresh and healthy grilled chicken salad with a citrus dressing.
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper.
Grill for 6-7 minutes per side until fully cooked.
Let chicken rest, then slice it thinly.
Toss mixed greens, cucumber, onion, and tomatoes in a bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.
Top with grilled chicken and serve.

name: Vegetarian Spinach and Ricotta Stuffed Shells
description: Baked pasta shells filled with creamy ricotta and spinach.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Boil pasta shells until al dente, then drain.
Mix ricotta, spinach, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
Fill each pasta shell with the ricotta mixture.
Spread marinara sauce in a baking dish, place stuffed shells on top.
Sprinkle mozzarella and Parmesan cheese over the shells.
Bake for 30 minutes until bubbly and golden.

name: Gluten-Free Peanut Butter Cookies
description: Chewy and delicious cookies made with peanut butter and no gluten.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Mix peanut butter, sugars, egg, and vanilla in a bowl.
Stir in baking soda and salt.
Scoop dough onto a baking sheet and press down with a fork.
Bake for 12 minutes until golden.
Let cool and enjoy.

name: Vegan Chickpea Wraps
description: A protein-packed chickpea wrap with a creamy tahini dressing.
instructions: Mash chickpeas in a bowl.
Mix with tahini, lemon juice, cumin, and salt.
Spread chickpea mixture onto tortillas.
Add cucumber and shredded carrots.
Roll up wraps and serve.

name: Nut-Free BBQ Chicken Wings
description: Crispy baked chicken wings tossed in homemade BBQ sauce.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Toss wings with olive oil, salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Bake for 35-40 minutes until crispy.
Toss with BBQ sauce and serve hot.

name: Gluten-Free Blueberry Pancakes
description: Fluffy pancakes made with gluten-Free flour and fresh blueberries.
instructions: Mix flour, sugar, and baking powder in a bowl.
Whisk in milk and egg until smooth.
Fold in blueberries.
Heat butter in a pan and cook pancakes until golden on both sides.
Serve with syrup.

name: Vegan Stir-Fried Tofu with Vegetables
description: A healthy stir-fry with tofu, bell peppers, and a savory sauce.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a pan.
Sauté garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add tofu and cook until golden brown.
Stir in vegetables and soy sauce.
Cook for 5 more minutes and serve.

name: Vegetarian Greek Salad
description: A refreshing salad with tomatoes, cucumbers, olives, and feta cheese.
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.
Toss gently and serve chilled.

name: Nut-Free Apple Crisp
description: A warm and comforting apple dessert with a cinnamon oat topping.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Toss apples with cinnamon and place in a baking dish.
Mix oats, brown sugar, and melted butter.
Sprinkle over apples and bake for 30 minutes.
Serve warm.

name: Vegan Sweet Potato Tacos
description: Delicious soft tacos filled with roasted sweet potatoes, black beans, and avocado.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Toss sweet potatoes with olive oil, cumin, chili powder, and salt.
Roast for 25 minutes until tender.
Warm tortillas and fill with roasted sweet potatoes, black beans, and avocado.
Serve with salsa or lime wedges.

name: Nut-Free Baked Salmon
description: A simple and flavorful baked salmon with lemon and herbs.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Place salmon fillets on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Top with lemon slices and bake for 15 minutes.
Serve hot with a side of vegetables.

name: Gluten-Free Banana Bread
description: Moist and delicious banana bread made with gluten-Free flour.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Mix mashed bananas, sugar, milk, and melted butter in a bowl.
Stir in gluten-Free flour, baking soda, and cinnamon.
Pour into a greased loaf pan and bake for 50 minutes.
Let cool before slicing.

name: Vegetarian Stuffed Peppers
description: Bell peppers stuffed with a savory mixture of rice, beans, and tomatoes.
